Nov 24 : Liverpool manager Andoni Iraola said Dutch duo Cody Gakpo and Ryan Gravenberch will miss Wednesday's Champions League clash against Club Brugge having also sat out Sunday's 4-0 win over Manchester United.
Gakpo returned from the international break with a calf injury and has also been ruled out of this weekend's Merseyside derby against Everton.
"I think with Cody it's a soleus injury, it's a muscle injury," Iraola told reporters on Tuesday. "It's not a big thing but I think we expected that he was out. He's going to be out even for the weekend. It's more predictable." 
Gravenberch, meanwhile, remains out with a heel fracture and has missed Liverpool's last three matches while continuing to manage the pain.

items.title: How the Iran war drove India and China to record Russian oil imports in 2026, and why purchases may ease in 2027
items.author: Bhanu Pratap
items.summary: India and China are set to import record Russian crude volumes in 2026 as the Iran war disrupts Middle Eastern supplies and US sanctions waivers ease purchases. But imports could ease in 2027 as Gulf supplies recover and Russian oil loses its price advantage.
items.body:
India and China are set to import record volumes of Russian crude oil in 2026 as the Iran war disrupts supplies from the Middle East, pushing refiners to seek alternative sources, Reuters reported.
Temporary US sanctions waivers have further eased access to Russian barrels, allowing the two countries to increase purchases at a time of heightened uncertainty in global energy markets,
However, the surge may prove temporary. Traders and analysts expect Russian oil demand in both countries to moderate in 2027 as Middle Eastern supplies become more readily available and the economics of buying Russian crude change.
Seaborne Russian oil shipments to India and China averaged around 3.4 million barrels per day (bpd) through mid-November, approximately 530,000 bpd higher than the corresponding period last year, according to tanker data and industry sources cited by Reuters.
The increase has provided Moscow with a significant boost to oil revenues, even as Ukrainian drone strikes have disrupted Russian refining capacity and forced more crude into export markets. Brent crude prices have also climbed nearly a third since the Iran war began, adding to volatility in global oil trade.How the Iran war changed Russian oil flowsThe disruption to Middle Eastern oil supplies following the Iran war has reshaped crude-buying patterns across Asia. As Iranian oil flows declined and concerns mounted over the availability of supplies from the Gulf, India and China increased their reliance on Russian crude to secure adequate feedstock for their refineries.Temporary US sanctions waivers targeting Russian oil have also helped buyers access more shipments by widening the pool of available vessels and suppliers.India and China together accounted for more than 80% of Russia's crude exports, according to estimates cited by Reuters.Moscow is also expecting its overall oil exports to rise this year. Russia's Ministry of Economic Development has forecast a 6% increase to 244.7 million metric tonnes, equivalent to approximately 4.9 million bpd.The higher exports underline how geopolitical disruptions have benefited Russia's oil trade. With traditional supply routes under pressure, Russian crude has become an important alternative for the world's two largest oil importers.India emerges as the biggest buyer of Russian crude
India's purchases of Russian oil have climbed to record levels, reinforcing its position as Moscow's largest seaborne crude buyer.
Data from tanker tracker Kpler cited by Reuters showed that India's Russian crude imports averaged 1.99 million bpd through early November, around 250,000 bpd higher than a year earlier.
The increase comes after Indian refiners had scaled back purchases earlier in the year amid concerns over the possibility of higher US tariffs.
However, the disruption to Middle Eastern supplies changed the buying calculus, making Russian crude more important for refiners seeking to maintain supplies.
Between January and October, India's Russian crude imports rose about 10% to 1.87 million bpd, accounting for approximately 38% of the country's total crude imports, according to trade sources cited by Reuters.
Indian refiners expect the full-year average to reach around 1.9 million bpd. The rise reflects both the availability of Russian barrels and the need to diversify supply sources as the Iran war puts pressure on flows from the Gulf.
Why China has also increased its Russian oil imports
China has also stepped up purchases, although its overall crude imports have declined.
Chinese customs data cited by Reuters showed that Russian oil shipments to the country rose 17% to 2.34 million bpd between January and October. The imports were valued at around $59.6 billion, with Russian crude accounting for roughly a quarter of China's total oil imports during the period.
This increase came even as China's overall crude imports fell 15%, highlighting the growing importance of Russian supplies in its import mix.Lower shipping risks and greater reliability have been key factors behind the shift. Muyu Xu, an analyst at tanker tracker Kpler, told Reuters that these considerations had driven the increase in China's Russian crude imports since the war began.Why Russian oil purchases could ease in 2027The outlook for Russian crude will depend significantly on how quickly Middle Eastern oil supplies recover and whether Russian barrels remain competitively priced.If Gulf supplies return to normal in 2027, Indian refiners are likely to have more alternatives.Sources at Indian refiners told Reuters that purchases of Russian crude could move back towards pre-Iran war levels, with buying decisions increasingly determined by price.China could follow a similar path. Greater availability of Middle Eastern crude may reduce the need for Russian supplies, particularly if Russian grades continue to trade at premiums rather than discounts.For Moscow, that could mean a tougher export environment next year. India and China have absorbed record volumes in 2026 partly because the Iran war disrupted their traditional sources of supply and made Russian crude more accessible.If those disruptions ease, Russia will have to compete more directly with oil from the Gulf and other producers. Its ability to retain market share will therefore depend less on geopolitical circumstances and more on the price, availability and shipping costs of its crude.
items.raw_description: India and China are set to import record Russian crude volumes in 2026 as the Iran war disrupts Middle Eastern supplies and US sanctions waivers ease purchases. But imports could ease in 2027 as Gulf supplies recover and Russian oil loses its price advantage.

items.title: A different job cut saga: First layoff emails to employees, then an apology - why this company did so? ‘Very sorry’
items.author: Livemint
items.summary: The bank has apologised after accidentally sending redundancy-related emails to employees before formally informing them about the outcome of their voluntary exit applications.
items.body:
An email intended for internal administrative communication ended up revealing some unwelcome news to employees of Australia's National Australia Bank (NAB). Several workers learnt that their jobs could be at risk through an automated notification before their managers had a chance to speak to them.
The bank has apologised after accidentally sending redundancy-related emails to employees before formally informing them about the outcome of their voluntary exit applications. The affected staff members were supposed to receive the decisions directly from their managers. However, an administrative or technical error resulted in the automated emails reaching them before those conversations could take place.
According to Reuters, NAB acknowledged the mistake and said it understood that receiving such news unexpectedly could cause distress.
"We are very sorry this happened, and that receiving an automated email this way would be upsetting and unsettling to many," the bank said in a statement shared with Reuters.
NAB said the notifications were not meant to be sent before employees were informed of the decisions through direct conversations. Following the incident, the bank said it would bring forward discussions with the affected workers.
Why is NAB planning to cut 2,500 jobs?
The email blunder comes as the Australian lender prepares for a major workforce restructuring. Last month, NAB announced plans to cut 2,500 jobs over the next 12 months, affecting approximately 6% of its total workforce.The bank said the restructuring is intended to simplify its operations and lower costs. As many as 1,500 roles, primarily across corporate functions, are expected to be affected by the end of this year.Which other Australian companies have announced job cuts?NAB's planned workforce reduction comes amid a wider wave of layoffs across Australia. Several companies, including Qantas, Canva, WiseTech and Atlassian, have also announced job cuts this year.For employees seeking voluntary redundancy, the process can already involve considerable uncertainty. Workers have to wait to find out whether their applications have been accepted, when their employment will end and what steps they need to take next.Receiving an unexpected automated email about an employment decision before a formal conversation with management can make an already stressful situation even more difficult.Businesses are increasingly turning to automated systems to handle routine employee communications, including recruitment updates, onboarding instructions, payroll notifications and internal announcements.While these tools help organisations save time and manage communication more efficiently, the NAB incident highlights the potential risks of using automation to deliver sensitive employment-related decisions that can directly affect people's livelihoods.

items.title: Macklem admits Bank of Canada offered mixed messaging on core inflation in past
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: The head of the Bank of Canada is admitting the central bank hasn’t always been clear in how it talks about its inflation target.
items.body: The Bank of Canada is keeping firm to its two per cent inflation target, but it’s adjusting what it tracks to get there. The federal government and the Bank of Canada renewed the central bank’s five-year mandate earlier this month and maintained the target for two per cent annual inflation, as measured by Statistics Canada’s consumer price index, or CPI. The central bank maintains a one-to-three per cent band around that target, which offers some wiggle room to execute monetary policy. Bank of Canada governor Tiff Macklem spoke to a business crowd in Toronto on Tuesday where he hailed the two per cent target as a “clear and well-understood objective” since it was implemented in 1995. Anchoring its policy rate decisions on that inflation target helped the Bank of Canada tame the post-COVID surge in inflation, Macklem argued in prepared remarks. But he acknowledged that Canadians didn’t respond well to inflation and the rate hikes it necessitated. “For many Canadians, it was their first experience with high inflation. And they didn’t like it. As we reviewed our framework, we held consultations across the country to hear from Canadians. We heard a lot of anger,” Macklem said. The head of the Bank of Canada acknowledged in his speech that the central bank could have done a better job in the post-pandemic period, which saw inflation pressures compound after Russia’s invasion of Ukraine. Monetary policymakers were “too slow to recognize the persistence of inflationary pressures and how broadly they were spreading through the economy,” Macklem said. He also acknowledged that the Bank of Canada has, at times, put focus on different measures of core inflation to track underlying price trends. The Bank of Canada previously downplayed its preferred measures of core inflation, CPI-trim and CPI-median, as it tried to gauge how supply shocks were affecting the economy. “We wanted to be transparent about where we saw inflation pressures and where we did not. But we weren’t as clear as we hoped,” Macklem said. “Canadians found it confusing when we discussed measures that strip out volatile prices such as food and gasoline. After all, these are important parts of the family budget. And financial market participants sometimes felt that we were moving the inflation goalposts.” Excluding the right measures can help give the Bank of Canada a clearer picture of inflation trends and cut through temporary forces pushing prices higher, Macklem said. Now, the Bank of Canada will put its focus back on an old measure called CPIX, which excludes eight fixed sets of items from the inflation calculation to provide a consistent benchmark of how prices are evolving. The Bank of Canada used CPIX to guide monetary policy decisions from 2001 to 2016. Some of the items excluded from CPIX are gasoline, mortgage interest costs and fruits and vegetables. The central bank will retain what’s called CPI-trim as its other core measure, which strips out the items seeing the most extreme price changes in each month. Macklem explained that, while the Bank of Canada’s updated core metrics can help monetary policymakers see where prices are headed, keeping overall inflation at two per cent remains the central bank’s north star. “Total CPI inflation is our target, and it will be front and centre in all our communications. Various indicators help us understand where inflation is headed and the risks around that forecast. But they are inputs to our analysis, not targets,” he said. -- This report by The Canadian Press was first published Nov. 24, 2026.
items.raw_description: The head of the Bank of Canada is admitting the central bank hasn’t always been clear in how it talks about its inflation target.

BOLOGNA, Italy, Nov 24 : Czech Republic's Tomas Machac beat Canada's Liam Draxl 6-2 3-6 6-2 on Tuesday as they took a 1-0 lead in their Davis Cup quarter-final, marking the two nations' first meeting in the premier international men's team competition.
The Czechs are chasing their first Davis Cup semi-final appearance in over a decade, while Canada are looking to make the last four for the first time since their 2022 title triumph.
Machac, the former world number 20 who won mixed doubles gold at the 2024 Paris Olympics, made a flying start against world number 154 Draxl, surging into a 4-0 lead in the first set.
Draxl got on the board at 4-1, but could not prevent Machac taking the opening set comfortably. Draxl battled back to force a decider, but Machac regained control by breaking for a 4-2 lead in the third before sealing victory in one hour 55 minutes.

World number 14 Jiri Lehecka is due to face Canada's Felix Auger-Aliassime, ranked 17th, in the second singles rubber before Adam Pavlasek and Patrik Rikl would take on Auger-Aliassime and Duncan Chan in the doubles.

Nov 24 : Argentina have been forced into six squad changes ahead of their Nations Championship seventh-place playoff against Scotland at Twickenham on Sunday, the Pumas said on Tuesday.
• Pablo Matera, who acted as captain during the competition this month, is out for personal reasons, while prop Boris Wenger has a facial injury suffered early in last Saturday’s 45-17 loss to France in Paris
• Wenger’s replacement Mayco Vivas was sent off in the second half and is suspended
• Argentina will also be without back Bautista Delguy, who is sidelined with a knee injury. He went off inside the opening 10 minutes last Saturday while Santiago Chocobares has a muscle injury, while Mateo Carreras is out with a shoulder injury

• The forward replacements are flanker Santiago Grondona, hooker Ignacio Ruiz and prop Rodrigo Martinez, who has won four caps since making his debut five years ago.

FAST

Nov 24 : Elon Musk asked a federal appeals court to overturn a jury verdict finding he defrauded Twitter shareholders out of billions of dollars by threatening to abandon his purchase of the social media company four years ago.
In a court filing on Monday night, Musk said shareholders failed to prove that Twitter's stock price fell on May 13, 2022, because he posted that the $44 billion takeover was "temporarily on hold" until Twitter demonstrated that its platform was not overrun by fake and spam accounts.
Musk told the San Francisco-based 9th US Circuit Court of Appeals that nothing linked the 9.7 per cent share price decline to $40.72 to any "material falsity" in his post, and that shareholders sought to hold him liable for securities fraud simply because the share price fell.
The world's richest person also said the trial judge should not have certified a class action because many investors likely did not rely on his post when selling Twitter shares.

Lawyers for the shareholders did not immediately respond to requests for comment on Tuesday. One of the lawyers has said Musk might owe $2.6 billion plus interest if the verdict stands.
Class actions let plaintiffs sue as a group, potentially leading to greater damages at lower cost than in individual lawsuits.
Shareholders accused Musk of expressing concern about fake and spam accounts to back out of the takeover or force Twitter to renegotiate a lower price.
They said Twitter's share price remained depressed until Musk agreed in October 2022 to complete his original $54.20 per share offer.
In upholding the verdict in July, US District Judge Charles Breyer in San Francisco found "substantial evidence of falsity" in Musk's May 13 tweet, and said qualms about completing a transaction "do not justify lying to the investing public."
Musk changed Twitter's name to X, and later folded it into his rocket and satellite company SpaceX. 

Source: Reuters

items.title: ベストバイ、通期売上高見通し上げ　年末商戦の需要に期待
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Juveria Tabassum

[２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Juveria Tabassum

[２４日 ロイター] - 米家電量販大手ベストバイは２４日、通期の既存店売上高伸び率見通しを引き上げた。消費者が人工知能（ＡＩ）搭載の新型携帯電話やテレビ、スマートグラスなどのウエアラブル端末に支出する中、年末商戦の堅調な需要を見込む。

通期の既存店売上高伸び率を３．４─４％と予想。従来見通しの１．９─３％から引き上げた。株価は午前の取引で２％超上昇した。

第３・四半期の売上高は５．８％増の１０２億４０００万ドル。ＬＳＥＧがまとめた予想の９９億ドルを上回った。同四半期の調整後１株利益は１．６２ドルと予想を上回った。同社は２７年度の調整後１株利益見通しを６．９０─７．０５ドルに引き上げた。

ジェーソン・ボンフィグ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）によると、テイクツー・インタラクティブの看板ゲームシリーズの待望の新作「グランド・セフト・オートＶＩ」の発売に備える顧客の需要を受け、第３・四半期はゲーム機本体や周辺機器の販売が伸びた。また、「健康管理用リング、ＡＩグラス、トレーディングカードや収集品といった新興カテゴリーが、既存店売上高の伸び率を約１ポイント押し上げている」とした。

幹部は決算説明会で、メモリー半導体のコスト上昇が製品価格を押し上げたものの、パソコン関連の需要は底堅さを維持したと説明した。

同四半期は１５００ドルを超える価格帯の販売が「非常に好調」だった。既存店売上高全体は６．１％増と、予想の２．３％増を大きく上回った。

今月初めにＣＥＯに就任したボンフィグ氏は、燃料費上昇の影響を和らげるため、サプライチェーン内で対応を進めていると述べた。

スティーフルのアナリスト、マイケル・モンタニ氏は、パソコン関連製品と携帯電話がけん引する既存店売上高の伸びは、年末商戦を控えたウォルマート、ターゲット、コストコなど他の小売大手の家電販売にとっても明るい兆候だと指摘した。

items.title: 米、過剰生産能力巡る調査結果近く公表へ　16カ国・地域に上乗せ関税か＝関係筋
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
David Lawder

[ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] -
items.body:
David Lawder

[ワシントン ２３日 ロイター] - トランプ米政権が、主要貿易相手国１６カ国・地域における過剰な産業生産能力への対抗を目的とした調査の結果を近く公表する見通しであることが分かった。この件に詳しい関係筋３人が２４日、明らかにした。これにより、幅広い品目を対象に新たな輸入関税が課されるものとみられる。

１９７４年通商法第３０１条に基づく調査の結果は、早ければ２４日か２５日にも公表される見通しだという。米通商代表部（ＵＳＴＲ）は、トランプ政権２期目にこれまで課してきた関税に上乗せする形で、新たな関税を提案するとみられる。

ＵＳＴＲは、米国の主要貿易相手国の大半について、産業の過剰生産能力を示す証拠について調査を進めてきた。対象は中国、欧州連合（ＥＵ）、インド、日本、韓国、メキシコ、ベトナム、台湾、タイ、マレーシア、インドネシア、スイス、ノルウェー、シンガポール、バングラデシュ、カンボジアの１６カ国・地域。

今回の関税は、米連邦最高裁が２月に無効とした世界的な輸入関税を部分的に置き換えるものとなる。トランプ政権による関税措置は米国内の消費財価格の上昇に一因となっており、１１月の中間選挙後に実施されたロイター／イプソスの世論調査では、回答者の６２％が関税撤廃に向けた取り組みを支持すると回答した。 

ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）は先に、この調査の結果が早ければ今週にも公表される可能性があると報じていた。

ＵＳＴＲとホワイトハウスは、関税発表に関するロイターの問い合わせに対し直ちには回答しなかった。

items.title: 中国シャオミ7─9月期、自動車市場低迷で57％減益　独への参入計画表明
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Ju-min Park

[北京 ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Ju-min Park

[北京 ２４日 ロイター] - 中国の電気自動車（ＥＶ）・スマートフォンメーカー、小米（シャオミ）が２４日発表した２０２６年第３・四半期（２６年７─９月期）決算は、総売上高が前年同期比５．２％減の１０７２億元、調整後純利益は５７％減の４９億元だった。ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想平均の５２億元を下回った。中国自動車市場の低迷や部品コストの上昇が響いた。海外展開の強化に向け、２７年後半にドイツの自動車市場に参入する計画も明らかにした。

シャオミの新エネルギー車（ＮＥＶ）、人工知能（ＡＩ）などの新規事業は営業損益が３４億元の赤字。ＮＥＶ事業の売上高は１９．９％減の２２７億元。車両納入台数は７．２％減の１０万９７５台だった。

シャオミは業界データを基に、７─９月期の中国の乗用車市場全体の小売販売は２４％減だったと説明。決算発表後の電話会議で、国内自動車市場の低迷は「全ての企業に大きな圧力」になっていると指摘した。コスト高や在庫増も課題となっているとも強調した。アナリストらは、シャオミの自動車事業は価格競争の激化や中国内自動車市場の低迷にさらされていると指摘している。

スマホの売上高は０．８％減。メモリーの調達コストが高止まりし粗利益率が低下。製品構成を高価格帯のモデルにシフトし、スマホの平均販売価格は前四半期から１０％上昇したという。

シャオミは、ＡＩや自社開発半導体、ロボット分野に関する投資を継続すると説明している。

items.title: EXCLUSIVE-マイクロソフトが「コードレッド」宣言、大規模障害受け対応見直し
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Jaspreet Singh

[２４日 ロイター] - 米マイクロソフトは今月発生した同社サービスの世界的な大規模障害を受け、障害の防止および危機対応体制を全面的に見直す「コードレッド（最も深刻かつ緊急性の高いアラート）」を宣言した。ロイターが入手した社内メモで明らかになった。

マイクロソフトは、今後障害が発生した場合、１時間以内の全世界復旧を目指すことを目標とする。エンジニアがシステムの健全性データをより迅速に診断できるよう、ＡＩエージェントを導入する計画だ。

マイクロソフトを巡っては今月、「チームズ」や「アウトルック」などを含む業務ソフト「マイクロソフト３６５」のサービスが約２４時間にわたり停止。世界の企業や政府機関の業務に大きな影響が及び、エンジニアリングシステムや危機対応体制の不備が露呈した。

マイクロソフトは、今後障害が発生した場合、１時間以内の全世界復旧を目指すことを目標とする。エンジニアがシステムの健全性データをより迅速に診断できるよう、ＡＩエージェントを導入する計画だ。

Ｍ３６５ Coreのジェイソン・ヘンダーソン社長は２０日、社内メモで、クラウド型メールサービス「エクスチェンジ・オンライン」において、これほど多くの顧客がこれほど長期間にわたりメールを利用できなくなった事例はかつてなかったと指摘。「コードレッドとは、われわれのチームにとって最優先の業務であることを意味する」と説明した。

同社の広報担当者は、問題発生時の迅速な解決だけでなく、将来的なサービス中断を防ぐために可能な限りの措置を講じることにコミットしていると強調。「サービスが復旧したからといって、われわれの仕事が終わったわけではない。各チームは得られた教訓を迅速に反映させ、経営陣はこれを最優先事項として徹底する」と述べた。

マイクロソフトは、今後障害が発生した場合、１時間以内の全世界復旧を目指すことを目標とする。エンジニアがシステムの健全性データをより迅速に診断できるよう、ＡＩエージェントを導入する計画だ。

マイクロソフトを巡っては今月、「チームズ」や「アウトルック」などを含む業務ソフト「マイクロソフト３６５」のサービスが約２４時間にわたり停止。世界の企業や政府機関の業務に大きな影響が及び、エンジニアリングシステムや危機対応体制の不備が露呈した。

Ｍ３６５ Coreのジェイソン・ヘンダーソン社長は２０日、社内メモで、クラウド型メールサービス「エクスチェンジ・オンライン」において、これほど多くの顧客がこれほど長期間にわたりメールを利用できなくなった事例はかつてなかったと指摘。「コードレッドとは、われわれのチームにとって最優先の業務であることを意味する」と説明した。

同社の広報担当者は、問題発生時の迅速な解決だけでなく、将来的なサービス中断を防ぐために可能な限りの措置を講じることにコミットしていると強調。「サービスが復旧したからといって、われわれの仕事が終わったわけではない。各チームは得られた教訓を迅速に反映させ、経営陣はこれを最優先事項として徹底する」と述べた。

Nov 24 : Former England captain Ben Stokes has registered for the 2027 Indian Premier League auction, Cricinfo reported on Tuesday, with the all-rounder entering the mini-player auction in Goa on December 16.
IPL rules barred players who skipped the mega auction from registering for the following mini auction, meaning Stokes could not return to the auction pool until 2027.
Indian media reported, however, that the 35-year-old has been granted permission by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) to enter this year's auction.
Stokes, who retired from international cricket this year, last played for Chennai Super Kings in 2023 and has scored 935 runs and taken 28 wickets in 45 IPL matches across five seasons.

Nov 24 : Jannik Sinner has had surgery for a persistent knee injury, the world number two said on Tuesday, extending the Italian's long absence from the tour and leaving him unlikely to compete at January's Australian Open.
"Over the past few months, together with my team we’ve tried everything to treat my injury without surgery," Sinner said in a statement.
"After some very encouraging progress early on, my knee unfortunately didn’t respond as we’d all hoped, that’s why today I underwent a minor surgery to improve the condition of my iliotibial band.
"I really miss being on court and will now begin my recovery process together with my team."

Italian sports daily Corriere dello Sport reported on Monday that Sinner had travelled to Turku, Finland for the surgery, which would leave him facing up to four months out and effectively rule him out of the first Grand Slam of 2027.
His team later confirmed the procedure was performed by orthopaedic surgeon Lasse Lempainen, who is based in Turku.
Sinner has been out of action with a right knee issue since claiming his fifth Grand Slam title at Wimbledon in July, but the Italian had been expected to return in time for the Australian Open starting in Melbourne on January 17.
However, the 25-year-old said earlier this month that he would not rush his recovery after the injury cut short a season in which he won the year's first five Masters 1000 titles as well as the Wimbledon crown.
Sinner recently parted ways with coach Darren Cahill after four years, with Swede Magnus Norman joining his coaching team as he plans his recovery and eventual bid to regain the world number one ranking.
With Sinner ending his season early and Carlos Alcaraz missing months of action with a wrist injury, Alexander Zverev climbed to world number one and sealed the year-end top ranking for the first time.
Alcaraz has made up for lost time since returning, winning four titles in a spectacular late-season surge that culminated with his maiden ATP Finals triumph in Turin. The Spaniard will seek his eighth major in Melbourne to extend his advantage over Sinner.

Source: Reuters

Nov 24 : Reaction to Senegal being reinstated as 2025 Africa Cup of Nations winners by a Court of Arbitration for Sport ruling on Tuesday.
SENEGALESE FOOTBALL FEDERATION (FSF) PRESIDENT ABDOULAYE FALL
"The Court of Arbitration for Sport has delivered justice for sport. I wish to strongly reaffirm the bonds of brotherhood that unite us with the Royal Moroccan Football Federation (FRMF) and the Moroccan people. Senegalese football now looks firmly towards the future with confidence and enthusiasm, in an Africa united around the values of sport."
SENEGALESE FOOTBALL FEDERATION ON INSTAGRAM.

“Again and always African champions.”
SENEGAL STRIKER SADIO MANE
"The decision of the Sport Arbitral Court to restore Senegal to its title of African champions fills us with joy. I want to first say thank you to all the Senegalese people, both in the country and in the diaspora. You've supported us from the first game until this decision. Your trust has given us strength in the most difficult times.
"I send a message of respect and encouragement to the Moroccan people and the players of Morocco. They've done a great course and can be proud of it. I wish them all the best for the future. Senegal and Morocco are two brotherly peoples. May the passion of football continue to bring us closer.
"Congratulations to all Senegalese. This victory is yours too."
FORMER SENEGAL CAPTAIN KALIDOU KOULIBALY
"Welcome back home."
FORMER SENEGAL INTERNATIONAL EL-HADJI DIOUF
"Football has won."
ROYAL MOROCCAN FOOTBALL FEDERATION STATEMENT
"The Royal Moroccan Football Federation (FRMF) expresses its objection to the fact that its request was not taken into consideration. The request concerned the legal consequences arising from actions that had compromised the proceedings and called into question the integrity and credibility of the decision, particularly after it was confirmed that contact had taken place between German arbitrator Ulrich Haas and the president of the Senegalese Football Federation 48 hours before the ruling was issued.
"Consequently, the Royal Moroccan Football Federation has decided to initiate all necessary legal proceedings to challenge the CAS decision."
COURT OF ARBITRATION FOR SPORT STATEMENT TO REUTERS
"CAS confirms it received a challenge against CAS Arbitrator Ulrich Haas by the FRMF, within one hour prior to the decision being announced. The Challenge came several hours after media reports stating it had already been filed.
"The ICAS (International Council of Arbitration for Sport, which oversees CAS) Challenge Commission found that there was not enough evidence at the time of the Challenge to delay the issuing of the decision. Ulrich Haas strongly denies any direct contact at any moment with the Parties involved in this procedure."
FSF SPOKESPERSON TO REUTERS ON ALLEGED CONTACT BETWEEN FSF AND HAAS
"That is false. There was no telephone contact on Sunday or on any other day."
CAS SECRETARY GENERAL MATTHIEU REEB
"The referee (Jean-Jacques Ndala of the Democratic Republic of Congo) did not commit any error of law ... There could only be one winner in this final, just as there could only be one winner in this legal process. The law has spoken. I think we simply have to accept the decision of the Court of Arbitration for Sport."
FSF LAWYER SIDY DIAGNE
"We could not allow the honour of Senegal, the Senegalese nation and its entire people to be trampled on like that under the pretext of legal proceedings that called into question the very essence of the sport, which is football. For us, this is a tremendous victory."
SOUTH AFRICA SPORTS MINISTER GAYTON MCKENZIE
"Senegal deserves credit for how it handled the last eight months. It didn’t give up and it didn't take the fight to the streets. It took its case to the proper forum and trusted the process. That should be the example for every federation on our continent."
SENEGAL FAN IN DAKAR
"The decision is well deserved for Senegal. We have truly earned this decision. There was no reason to be stressed. We had nothing to fear because we knew that whatever happened, we are champions and we will remain champions."
SECOND SENEGAL FAN IN DAKAR
"A match should be decided on the pitch, not in the courts. Otherwise, it would have set a precedent, a legal precedent, and for me, it would have meant the end of football."
(Compiled by Nick Said, editing by Ed Osmond and Ken Ferris)

items.title: World stocks are mixed after Wall Street's rebound as Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia’s CEO
items.author: The Associated Press
items.summary: HONG KONG — Global stocks were mixed Tuesday after a rally on Wall Street as Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia’s CEO. U.S. futures edged higher. Oil prices extended their losses, falling close to their ...
items.body: NEW YORK — Stocks tied to the artificial intelligence industry are leading the U.S. market lower once again on Tuesday. That’s even though much of the rest of Wall Street is rising, along with confidence among Americans in the economy. The S&P 500 fell 0.5 per cent after dropping as much as 1.4 per cent earlier, and it’s heading toward its eighth loss in the last nine days. Tech stocks led the way lower in a turnaround from Monday’s surge and dragged the Nasdaq composite down a market-leading 1.3 per cent, as of 10:05 a.m. Eastern time. But the majority of U.S. stocks were nevertheless rising, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average was up 271 points, or 0.5 per cent. It’s the latest swing for a market that has been mostly sinking since setting its all-time high last month. The worry is that prices for AI-related stocks shot too high into a possible bubble and need to deflate. That carries immense consequences for the broader market and workers’ 401(k) accounts because AI stocks have grown so big that they’ve become Wall Street’s most influential sector. While the return of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang does bring back a charismatic leader who championed and helped build the entire AI industry, it does not settle the deep concerns dogging it. For one, doubts remain about whether AI can possibly produce enough profit and productivity to make the massive investments underway in data centres worth it. At the same time, high interest rates in the bond market caused in part by the war with Iran are making it more difficult to borrow money to pay for the industry’s growth. Sweeping victories for Democrats earlier this month in the U.S. midterm elections, meanwhile, have raised concerns about more regulation for AI, including possible halts to further construction of data centres. To be sure, AI stocks and the broader U.S. market have been prone to extreme reversals since the summer, not only week to week but even hour to hour. For now, at least, the momentum is back downward. Nvidia fell 6.6 per cent a day after soaring 31.5 per cent to its biggest gain in more than two decades. Other stocks around the AI industry fell by similar amounts. CoreWeave, which buys Nvidia chips and rents out access to them over the cloud, sank 9 per cent. GE Vernova, which is helping to power AI data centres, fell 4.6 per cent. And Anthropic, the company behind the Claude AI chatbot, tumbled 7.4 per cent to drop below US$83. That’s how much Anthropic first sold its stock for in its initial public offering last week. The stock had briefly jumped as high as US$115 in its first day of trading amid a frenzy of hype. Such drops were powerful enough to offset gains for the slight majority of stocks on Wall Street. They rose following the latest report to say confidence among U.S. consumers is improving by more than economists expected. Companies in industries across the economy also continue to report strong growth in profits for the summer. That helped the majority of stocks within the S&P 500 to rise. Dollar Tree climbed 11.3 per cent after reporting better earnings for the latest quarter than analysts expected. The average shopper spent slightly more in its stores during the three months than a year earlier, and more of them came than last year. Kohl’s rallied 13 per cent after reporting a profit for the latest quarter, when analysts were expecting basically zero. It also gave forecasts for revenue for the final three months of its fiscal year that were better than expected. The retailers are among the latest companies to join the long list of big U.S. companies delivering bigger profit for the summer than analysts expected. Businesses in the S&P 500 are on pace to report overall growth in earnings per share of more than 25 per cent for a third straight quarter, according to FactSet. Stock prices tend to follow the path of corporate profits and interest rates over the long term. But emotions of investors can also overwhelm them in the short term, as the last few weeks have demonstrated. In the bond market, Treasury yields slipped as investors moved into investments seen as safer bets. The yield on the 10-year Treasury fell to 4.91 per cent from 4.92 per cent late Monday. That was despite a rise in oil prices, which tend to push upward on inflation and on bond yields. The price for a barrel of Brent crude oil rose 1.8 per cent to US$88.26. It’s been yo-yoing between US$72 and US$114 since the United States and Israel attacked Iran in February. In stock markets abroad, indexes were mixed across Europe and Asia. South Korea’s Kospi jumped 6.3 per cent, and Japan’s Nikkei 225 rallied 3.9 per cent for two of the world’s bigger moves, as they caught up to Monday’s surge from Wall Street. ___ Stan Choe, The Associated Press AP Writer Elaine Lai contributed to this report

items.summary:
After a week of whiplash over Jensen Huang’s future and new US chip curbs, Beijing sent a clear message to Washington about their trade truce: China is holding up its side of the bargain — for now.
That decision was seen as an important test of a detente between the world’s largest economies after the US this month imposed new rules to limit Chinese access to advanced semiconductors.
Admiral James Stavaridis, Retired US Navy Admiral and Bloomberg Opinion columnist, discusses the national security risks associated with Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia, developments in the war in Iran, and the latest from Ukraine. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: エヌビディア株反落、フアン氏復帰の熱狂一服　政治・統治リスク再評価
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Deborah Mary Sophia　Shashwat Chauhan

[２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Deborah Mary Sophia　Shashwat Chauhan

[２４日 ロイター] - ２４日の取引で、米半導体大手エヌビディアの株価は大幅反落した。ジェンスン・フアン氏の最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）への電撃復帰を受けた株価急騰は早くも勢いを失い、投資家の関心は同社の政治面や企業統治面のリスクに再び向かっている。

株価は直近で５％超下落。２３日には３１．５％急騰し、時価総額が９５２０億ドル余り増加していた。前日に上昇した他の人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株も値下がりした。

エヌビディアはトランプ米大統領の圧力を受け、不倫問題の発覚で辞任したフアン氏を復帰させた。一連の急展開は市場を揺さぶり、同社の技術や資金に依存するＡＩ関連業界にも動揺を広げた。

テロス・ウェルス・アドバイザーズのポートフォリオ運用責任者、ダン・シーハン氏は「復帰そのものが、疑問を解消するのと同じくらい新たな疑問を生んでいる。同氏の復帰で大きな不確実性は取り除かれたが、エヌビディアの企業統治がどう評価されるかという懸念は残る」と指摘。「今後、政府がエヌビディアにどの程度関与するのかという疑問もある。また、復帰という判断が暗に示した姿勢を踏まえると、社内の行動規範をどう管理するかも問われる。株価が急騰しても、こうした問題は解決しない」と語った。

米議会では与野党の議員がエヌビディアの決定を厳しく批判し、フアン氏の復帰を巡る経緯を議会が精査すべきだと訴えた。

＜続く調査＞

フアン氏とエヌビディアはともに、米連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）、司法省、証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）など、州・連邦当局による多数の捜査や審査の対象となっている。

１２月３日には上院の公開公聴会が予定され、フアン氏が証言する見通し。外国の情報機関による活動の可能性や国家安全保障、輸出管理を巡る取締役会独自の調査も続いている。

アンダーセン・キャピタル・マネジメントの創業者、ピーター・アンダーセン氏は「騒ぎが落ち着き始め、人々は（エヌビディアの）決定をより批判的に検討するようになっている。取締役会は自らの決定によって、倫理面と法的な面で極めて大きなリスクを背負った」と述べた。フアン氏による今後の証言も「同社にとって極めて大きなリスク」だと指摘した。

２３日の急騰により、エヌビディアは世界の時価総額ランキングでアップルに次ぐ２位に返り咲いた。ただ、株価はなお１０月６日に付けた過去最高値を約３１％下回っている。

半導体やデータセンター関連銘柄を含むＡＩ関連企業の株価も大幅に上昇し、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種指数の構成銘柄の時価総額は２兆８０００億ドル余り増加した。

テロスのシーハン氏は「２３日の動きは驚きだったが、危機を脱した兆候とは受け止めていない。１つのニュースで時価総額が３兆ドル増える市場は、別のニュースで同じように急落する可能性がある」と述べた。

アンダーセン・キャピタル・マネジメントの創業者、ピーター・アンダーセン氏は「騒ぎが落ち着き始め、人々は（エヌビディアの）決定をより批判的に検討するようになっている。取締役会は自らの決定によって、倫理面と法的な面で極めて大きなリスクを背負った」と述べた。フアン氏による今後の証言も「同社にとって極めて大きなリスク」だと指摘した。

２３日の急騰により、エヌビディアは世界の時価総額ランキングでアップルに次ぐ２位に返り咲いた。ただ、株価はなお１０月６日に付けた過去最高値を約３１％下回っている。

半導体やデータセンター関連銘柄を含むＡＩ関連企業の株価も大幅に上昇し、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種指数の構成銘柄の時価総額は２兆８０００億ドル余り増加した。

テロスのシーハン氏は「２３日の動きは驚きだったが、危機を脱した兆候とは受け止めていない。１つのニュースで時価総額が３兆ドル増える市場は、別のニュースで同じように急落する可能性がある」と述べた。

FAST

Nov 24 : Microsoft has declared a "Code Red" drive to overhaul how it prevents and responds to major service failures after a 24-hour outage exposed shortcomings in its engineering systems and crisis response, according to internal memos reviewed by Reuters.
The November 12-13 outage hit governments from Australia and Japan to the United States, delayed trading firms and disrupted airline communications, fueling broader concerns about the vulnerability of critical digital infrastructure. Microsoft said the incident was not related to cyber activity or AI agents.
Microsoft blamed the outage on an undetected Windows scalability defect introduced in July. CEO Satya Nadella publicly apologized for the disruption.
The Code Red signified the most severe and urgent alert to address weaknesses in Microsoft's engineering and operational practices after the outage disrupted Exchange Online, its cloud-based email service, as well as Outlook, Teams, its Copilot AI assistant and other Microsoft 365 products.

It was the most customer-impacting incident in the history of Exchange Online, M365 Core President Jason Henderson said in a memo to staff on Friday.
Never before had so many customers been without email for so long, he said. "Code Red means that this is the highest priority work for our team," Henderson added.
'FOG OF WAR'
Amanda Silver, Microsoft's corporate vice president overseeing M365 Core and Work IQ, the company's workplace intelligence platform for AI agents, said in a separate memo on Monday that engineers had to work through a "fog of war" as the outage unfolded.
Despite deploying top engineering personnel, responders exchanged more than 11,000 messages across 11 Teams chats and struggled to maintain a cohesive picture of hypotheses and decisions because diagnostic data was scattered across fragmented internal tracking systems, Silver said.
Charles Lamanna, Microsoft's executive vice president of Copilot, Agents and Platform, told a Code Red review that the affected component had experienced "roughly ten years' worth of acceptable failures," according to Silver's memo.
"Our work doesn't end when service is restored. Our teams keep working around the clock to quickly implement any lessons learned, and our leadership makes sure this is our top priority," a company spokesperson told Reuters when contacted about the memos.
RECOVERY TARGET
As part of the Code Red, a high-priority mobilization reserved for critical crises, Silver outlined five workstreams focused on load shedding, geographic traffic partitioning and faster recovery mechanisms.
Microsoft set a target of achieving worldwide resolution within an hour during future incidents and plans to deploy AI agents to help engineers diagnose system health data more quickly.
Henderson said he would hold daily meetings with the Substrate leadership team, which oversees the engineering group responsible for underlying Microsoft 365 services, to track actions stemming from the outage, along with weekly reviews.
The company spokesperson said Microsoft is committed not only to resolving issues when they occur, but to doing everything possible to prevent future disruptions.
SLOW PATCH DEPLOYMENTS
"Unfortunately, all the work we have done over the years was not sufficient to protect us on Thursday," Henderson said, adding that he had conducted an extensive review of the broader organizational and structural issues that allowed the failures to occur.
In another memo earlier this month reviewed by Reuters, Henderson said "urgent patches to our M365 Core services" took too long to deploy worldwide.
"In a separate recent incident, an urgent production fix took five to six days to reach worldwide saturation. For our most urgent security issues, we need to get from detection to safe worldwide deployment in an hour. Needless to say, we aren't here yet," he wrote.

Source: Reuters

US lawmakers raise alarm at FAA decision to deploy aviation AI tool nationally

A view of the control tower at Newark Liberty International Airport in Newark, New Jersey, US, November 14, 2026. REUTERS/Eduardo Munoz

Administrator of the US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Bryan Bedford speaks during the "Red, Flight & Blue: The Future of U.S. Aviation," forum at The Hay-Adams hotel, near The White House, in Washington, DC, US, November 18, 2026. REUTERS/Nathan Howard/File Photo

FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 24 : A group of two dozen House Democrats on Tuesday raised serious concerns about the Federal Aviation Administration decision to deploy a new AI tool to assist air traffic controllers nationwide on November 10, days before a major system failure.
The FAA in September began using a new software-based AI tool system in the Washington area that uses predictive analytics to improve how flights are managed after awarding an $875 million, 12-year contract to Air Space Intelligence.
The Democrats, led by Representative Rick Larsen of Washington, the ranking member of the House Transportation Committee, criticized the "sudden expansion of a largely untested system" and asked the FAA to answer a series of questions by November 30. "We have yet to receive any substantive information proving the system was properly validated before its nationwide expansion," the lawmakers wrote.
The system, dubbed Strategic Management of Airspace, Routes, and Trajectories, or SMART, uses data to analyze airline schedules, weather, airport capacity, airspace conditions and operational constraints to predict traffic flows and identify potential conflicts before they occur.

The letter cited the nearly five-hour November 13 nationwide ground stop that led flights to be canceled for an estimated 1.5 million passengers due to an FAA telecom issue.
"The federal government is dealing with a crisis of confidence," the letter said. "Americans’ faith in the aviation system is shaken. The opacity and inconsistency with which the FAA has handled the SMART rollout threatens to
further undermine that trust."
The lawmakers want to know the data used by the FAA to validate SMART operations and what redundancies are in place to "ensure reliable ATC operations in the event of issues or outages impacting SMART."
The lawmakers also cited reports that the FAA may have retaliated against employees who raised safety concerns about SMART’s rapid deployment.
The FAA declined comment and said it would respond directly to the lawmakers.
US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy has called the tool essentially "dumb AI" and emphasized controllers remain in charge, not the software.
The system uses over 200 data streams, creates data visualizations, and produces scheduling recommendations for operations experts to consider passing along but does not involve active management of planes in the sky.

Source: Reuters

items.summary: [アムステルダム ２４日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行
items.body:
[アムステルダム ２４日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行 （ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのスレイペン・オランダ中銀総裁は２４日、ＥＣＢは１２月の理事会で利上げに踏み切る公算が大きいが、その後の道筋は不透明であるとの見方を示した。

スレイペン氏はアムステルダムで記者団に対し、「われわれは理事会ごとに判断を下す方法を取っているため、次回１２月の理事会で決定することになる。ただ、方向性は明確だと思う」と述べた。

ドイツ連邦銀行（中央銀行）のナーゲル総裁を含む多くのＥＣＢ政策担当者は、ユーロ圏のインフレ率が高すぎるため、ＥＣＢは来月に金融引き締めを迫られる公算が大きいと述べている。

さらに同氏は、多くの不確実性があり次に何が起こるかを見通すことが難しいため、２０２７年の金融政策の見通しについては言及を避けた。そうした不確実性には、フランスなどの国における債務コストの上昇に関連するリスクも含まれると述べた。

items.title: Copper price erases Nvidia rebound as investors steer clear of metals
items.author: Frik Els
items.creator: Staff Writer
items.summary: Traders have booked up to 100,000 tonnes of US copper for China, a sign they are losing faith in tariffs, BMO Capital Markets says.
items.body:
Copper price erases Nvidia rebound as investors steer clear of metals
Traders have booked up to 100,000 tonnes of US copper for China, a sign they are losing faith in tariffs, BMO Capital Markets says.

Staff Writer
|
November 24, 2026 - 10:53 am

Categories:
Markets

Stock image.

Copper gave back all of Monday’s artificial intelligence-fuelled gains on Tuesday as investors who dumped metals during the recent AI rout showed little appetite to return, and traders kept moving US stockpiles to China.

Comex copper for December delivery fell 3.5% to $5.437 a pound ($11,985 a tonne) in morning trade in New York. A settlement at that level would be the lowest since March 24. The contract settled at $5.634 on Monday, up 2.7% but well off the session high of $5.787 reached after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive.

Tuesday’s drop leaves copper 21% below its record settlement of $6.889 on September 9, technically a bear market. The metal is now down 3% this year and 16% in November.

Three-month copper on the London Metal Exchange was down 3.5% at $12,054 a tonne in official trading after briefly ducking below $12,000, Reuters reports. It had jumped as much as 5.3% on Monday.

Investors who sold commodities during the AI rout that followed Huang’s resignation on November 12 are not rushing back.

“These investors are not fully reengaging the positions they had pre-event, which includes commodity exposure,” Panmure Liberum analyst Tom Price told Reuters. Many have decided copper is too volatile and are cutting commodity exposure to concentrate on AI stocks, he said.

“There are now multiple reasons for the market to short copper,” Aces Zhou, a base metals trader at Hangzhou Chenglian Industrial, told Bloomberg. Beyond the AI narrative, he said, trade flows are starting to reverse as copper leaves the United States, and the factors that supported the metal’s two-year rally are unravelling.

Rate hikes and a strong dollar add to the headwinds. Markets are fully pricing a quarter-point increase at the Federal Reserve’s December meeting, which would be the second this year, Bloomberg reports, and the dollar index is at its highest since March 2025, according to BMO Capital Markets.

US metal heads to China

The physical market remains tight, but financial flows have overpowered it, BMO’s analysts wrote after attending Asia Copper Week in Shanghai last week. Visible exchange inventories cover only about two days of consumption, and the Yangshan premium for imports into China climbed from under $100 a tonne to around $500 in a month.

Those premiums, together with a narrowing gap between New York and London prices, have prompted traders to book an estimated 30,000 to 100,000 tonnes of US cathode for direct shipment to China, BMO said. The metal, held outside exchange warehouses on the US west coast, takes about two weeks to arrive.

The shipments matter less for the tonnage than for what they signal, BMO said: that traders are losing confidence in a tariff decision that would keep US stockpiles sealed off from the rest of the world. Chinese industry players expect President Donald Trump to drop plans for duties on refined copper, while Western participants still lean towards a tariff being imposed.

BMO expects the selloff to extend until Washington signals its tariff intentions or prices fall far enough to hit supply, potentially in the $10,000 to $11,000 a tonne range. Trafigura’s cost curve shows about 10% of copper produced by solvent extraction and electrowinning is already losing money at around $13,000, the bank said. BMO stands by its structurally bullish medium-term view.

Smelters squeezed

Talks on 2027 treatment charges, the fees miners pay smelters to process concentrate, remain far apart. Antofagasta has reportedly offered around minus $200 a tonne, while China’s Tongling has signalled about minus $80 could be acceptable, according to BMO.

This year’s benchmark was set at zero, already a record low, and BMO estimates some Chinese smelters break even on a cash basis at around minus $90. A deeply negative 2027 benchmark could speed up output cuts, especially as falling sulphuric acid prices erode by-product income.

Mine supply remains tight. Global copper mine production fell 1% year on year in September and is down 1% over the first nine months of 2026, the International Copper Study Group said in its latest monthly bulletin. Output from Chile slumped 15% and Peru 9% in the month, more than offsetting gains in Indonesia, China and the Democratic Republic of Congo. Refined demand fell 2% from a year earlier, slightly more than supply, leaving the refined market in deficit for the month, though it remains in surplus for the year to date.

Miners give back gains

Copper stocks reversed much of Monday’s rally. Freeport-McMoRan fell 5% at the New York open, cutting its market value to $68 billion, and Southern Copper lost 4% to $117 billion. Teck Resources dropped 4% to $25 billion, while BHP slipped 2% to $174 billion and Rio Tinto 2% to $125 billion. The five New York-listed heavyweights shed about $15 billion in the first minutes of trading, after adding more than $25 billion on Monday.

In London, Antofagasta dropped 7%, Anglo American almost 6% and Glencore 4%, while Poland’s KGHM fell 7%. In Toronto, First Quantum Minerals lost 6%, Lundin Mining and Hudbay Minerals 5% each and Ivanhoe Mines 4%.

BHP this week outlined plans to spend up to $17.4 billion to roughly double copper output in South Australia to about 650,000 tonnes a year by 2040, with a final investment decision expected in the first half of 2027.

First Quantum Minerals and Panama opened formal negotiations on Monday over the Cobre Panama mine, shut since 2023, after the company accepted the government’s five conditions for talks, including recognition that Panama owns the mineral resource.

Trader Trafigura has taken full control of the $260 million La Farola copper-gold project in Chile, buying the remaining 50% of owner Minera Altair as it moves from trading concentrate into mine development. In Santiago, the price slump is threatening President José Antonio Kast’s budget plans , as copper accounts for about half of the country’s exports.

(With files from Reuters and Bloomberg)

items.title: ゼレンスキー氏、フィンランド湾のロシア貨物船攻撃認める　「正当な標的」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Yuliia Dysa　Gwladys Fouche

[キーウ／オスロ　２４日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Yuliia Dysa　Gwladys Fouche

[キーウ／オスロ　２４日　ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、フィンランド湾でロシアの貨物船を標的にした２１日のドローン（無人機）攻撃について、ウクライナが実施したと認めた。一方、ウクライナを強く支援するノルウェーは、こうした作戦の実施に当たり慎重な対応を求めた。

ゼレンスキー大統領はブルームバーグが２３日に行ったインタビューで、正当な軍事目標を攻撃したとし、ウクライナは「全て適切に実施した」と述べ、「ロシア国旗を掲げる船舶や、兵器・制裁対象貨物を運搬する船舶、積み荷の内容が不明な船舶は、ロシア領海内であれ公海上であれ、われわれにとって正当な標的になる」と語った。

その上で、今回の攻撃はロシア領海内で実施されたとし、「われわれにはその権利が十分にあった。ただ、その後に何らかの逸脱が生じた可能性があり、当然ながら疑問が生じている」と語った。同時に、欧州の一部同盟国が「バルト海で何かが起きると懸念している」とし、十分な情報が共有され不意打ちと受け取られることがないよう、閣僚や軍に対しパートナー国との意思疎通を強化するよう指示したと述べた。

フィンランドとエストニアの間にあるフィンランド湾で攻撃を受けた貨物船「スパルタ２」はロシア海運会社オボロンロジスチカが所有。同社のウェブサイトによると、オボロンロジスチカはロシア国防省向けの物流業務を担っている。スパルタ２は２１日にドローンによる攻撃を受けて火災を起こし、消火にフィンランド、エストニア、ロシアの船舶が共同で対応。２２日にロシア領海内に曳航され、現在はロシア北西部サンクトペテルブルクの港に停泊している。フィンランド軍は当初から攻撃はウクライナが実行した可能性が高いとの見解を示していた。

items.title: アンソロピック一時12％安、公募価格割れ　時価総額2000億ドル減の勢い
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Medha Singh

[２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Medha Singh

[２４日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックが２４日の取引で一時１２％強下落し、新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）価格を下回った。時価総額約２０００億ドルを消失する勢いとなっており、ＡＩ企業の高騰した評価額やコンピューティングインフラに投じられている巨額資金への懸念が強まる可能性がある。

株価は一時１２．６％安の７６．６０ドルと、ＩＰＯ価格の８３ドルを下回った。

アンソロピックは１９日、ナスダック市場に新規上場した。主要ＡＩ開発企業としては世界初の上場で、ＡＩブームの持続性を占う試金石として市場の注目を集めた。初値はＩＰＯ価格を約３４％上回る１１１．５０ドル。その後は１７％高で初日の取引を終えた。ただ、その後はハイテク株全般の売りに押され、下落基調となっている。

２３日は、半導体大手エヌビディアがジェンスン・フアン氏を最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）に復帰させたことが好感され、米株式市場はＡＩ関連株主導で急反発した。しかし、アンソロピックはその上昇相場に乗ることができず、下落して取引を終えた。

ストーンＸのシニアマーケットアナリスト、フィオナ・シンコッタ氏は「データセンター投資の拡大ペースに鈍化が見られれば、アンソロピックの開発スピードに影響を及ぼすことは明らかで、いずれは将来の収益や企業価値にも影響が及ぶだろう」と述べた。

ＩＰＯ後に公募価格を下回ったハイテク関連大手はアンソロピックだけではない。６月に上場した宇宙開発企業スペースＸ は約１カ月後にＩＰＯ価格を下回ったほか、２０１２年にはフェイスブック（現メタ)が上場２日目に公募価格を割り込んだ。

ただ、指数算出会社ＭＳＣＩは１１月３０日の取引終了後、アンソロピック株をグローバル・スタンダード指数に組み入れる予定で、株価の支援材料となる可能性がある。

ストーンＸのシニアマーケットアナリスト、フィオナ・シンコッタ氏は「データセンター投資の拡大ペースに鈍化が見られれば、アンソロピックの開発スピードに影響を及ぼすことは明らかで、いずれは将来の収益や企業価値にも影響が及ぶだろう」と述べた。

ＩＰＯ後に公募価格を下回ったハイテク関連大手はアンソロピックだけではない。６月に上場した宇宙開発企業スペースＸ は約１カ月後にＩＰＯ価格を下回ったほか、２０１２年にはフェイスブック（現メタ)が上場２日目に公募価格を割り込んだ。

ただ、指数算出会社ＭＳＣＩは１１月３０日の取引終了後、アンソロピック株をグローバル・スタンダード指数に組み入れる予定で、株価の支援材料となる可能性がある。

MANCHESTER, England, Nov 24 : Manchester United defender Leny Yoro will not serve a suspension after his red card in Sunday's 4-0 Premier League defeat at Liverpool was overturned following a successful wrongful dismissal claim.
Yoro was sent off in the eighth minute at Anfield for denying an obvious goal-scoring opportunity after bringing down Liverpool striker Alexander Isak just outside the penalty area.
Dominik Szoboszlai scored from the resulting free kick.
"The player's one-match suspension has been removed following a successful claim of wrongful dismissal," the Football Association said in a statement on Tuesday.

FAST

Nov 24 : Copa America will return to the United States in 2028, the CONMEBOL and CONCACAF soccer federations announced on Tuesday, marking the country's second consecutive time hosting the competition. 
Six teams from North America, Central America and the Caribbean will join 10 South American sides in the tournament, which runs from June 9 to July 9, 2028. The CONCACAF teams will qualify through the 2027 Gold Cup. 
The US hosted the last edition of Copa America in 2024, where Argentina defeated Colombia in the final. The US also held the tournament in 2016, with the Americans finishing fourth. 
“After our collaboration in 2024, we are pleased to join forces again to bring the CONMEBOL Copa America to our region in 2028," CONCACAF President Victor Montagliani said in a statement.

The federations said they will announce details about host cities and venues at a later date. 
“The CONMEBOL Copa America is much more than a tournament: it is part of our identity, our history, and the greatness of South American football," CONMEBOL President Alejandro Domínguez said in a statement.
"In 2028, we will once again bring that passion to the United States, reaffirming our historic partnership with CONCACAF and our shared commitment to continuing to drive the growth of football across the continent."

items.title: 米ＣＢ消費者信頼感、11月は約2年ぶり高水準　中間選挙受け楽観広がる
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン　２４日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン　２４日　ロイター] - 米民間調査機関コンファレンス・ボード（ＣＢ）が２４日発表した１１月の消費者信頼感指数は１０３．３と、２０２５年１月以来、約２年ぶりの高水準を付けた。今月の中間選挙を受けて、労働市場や景気全般に対する楽観的な見方が広がった。信頼感の大幅な改善は、民主党支持者と無党派層の回答者がけん引した。一方、信頼感は共和党支持者の間ではわずかに低下した。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は９２．５だった。

１０月分は当初発表の９１．７から９１．９に上方改定された。

信頼感の改善は、全ての年齢層・世代に及び、世帯所得が高い消費者で最も大きかった。

ＣＢのシニアエコノミスト、ファーガス・マコーミック氏は「消費者信頼感は１１月に再び回復した。中間選挙後に不透明感が和らいだことが一因とみられる」と指摘。「１１月の自由記述回答では、これまでの数カ月よりもやや否定的な内容が少なかった。消費者は依然として高い物価やコスト上昇への不満を示したが、一部のコメントでは、経済全般に対する期待が示されていた」と述べた。

雇用が「豊富」との回答は３０．８と、１０月の２６．２から急上昇し、２５年５月以来の高水準となった。「仕事が見つかりにくい」と回答の割合は１８．４と、前月の２１．４から低下し、２５年１０月以来の低さとなった。職が「十分」と「就職困難」の回答から算出する労働市場格差に関する指数は１２．４と、前月の４．８から拡大した。

１１月の１年後のインフレ期待の中央値は４．５％と、前月の４．７％から低下したものの、依然として高い水準にある。

物価上昇への不安が続く中でも、今後６カ月以内に自動車や大型家電を購入する予定の消費者の割合は増加した。住宅ローン金利の高止まりや住宅価格の上昇にもかかわらず、今後６カ月以内に住宅を購入する予定の消費者の割合は７カ月ぶりの高水準に上昇した。

items.title: エヌビディアのフアンＣＥＯ復帰、中国で歓迎も米中の政治的圧力重く
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Eduardo Baptista　Xiuyuan Ning

[北京　２４日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Eduardo Baptista　Xiuyuan Ning

[北京　２４日　ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアの最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）にジェンスン・フアン氏が復帰したことは、米中間の技術連携を最も強力に支持してきた人物の一人が戻ってきたことを意味する。ただ、フアン氏が復帰する事業環境は、米中双方で政治的圧力が強まる中、より規制が厳格化されたものになる。 

トランプ米大統領の介入を受けて２３日にフアン氏が復帰したことを中国の投資家は歓迎した。しかし、米国政府は先端半導体への中国のアクセスをさらに厳しく制限し、中国の国営系メディアは技術面での自給自足を改めて呼びかけた。

中国でフアン氏ほど人気を集める米国人経営者はほとんどいない。台湾生まれの同氏は昨年７月に北京を訪れた際、ファンと自撮り写真を撮り、革ジャンにサインをした。貿易見本市では中国の伝統衣装を身にまとい、エヌビディアのライバルであるファーウェイ（華為技術）を含む中国のテック企業を称賛した。

調査会社オムディアのチーフアナリスト、リアン・ジェ・ス氏は、２４日のアジアのテック株の急騰は、世界の人工知能（ＡＩ）業界におけるフアン氏の重要性と、分断が深まる中国と西側の経済をつなぐ同氏の能力を物語っていると述べた。 

ただ、フアン氏が果たしてきた米中間の架け橋としての役割が弱まったとの見方から、中国株は世界的な上昇相場に遅れを取った。

中国政府系大衆紙の環球時報は２４日の社説で、フアン氏の復帰を米政府が半導体規制を緩和する兆候と解釈すべきではないと警告し、中国が半導体の自給自足を強化する必要性を改めて強調した。 

＜狭まる余地＞

フアン氏は、中国のスパイとされる中国人女性実業家アリス・フアン氏との関係を含む複数の不貞行為が明るみに出たことを受け、１１月１２日に辞任したものの、トランプ大統領の関与で、わずか１１日での異例の復帰となった。 

だが、フアン氏が戻った事業環境は、以前よりはるかに厳しいものとなっている。

米商務省は２３日、エヌビディア問題の渦中にあるシンガポールのクラウド企業メガスピード、同社とビジネス関係がある中国企業アリババのシンガポール子会社アペックス・エンタープライズ・ソリューションズ （Apex Enterprise Solutions）を貿易ブラックリスト（輸出規制リスト）に追加した。

この措置は、米商務省が先週発表した、シンガポール、タイ、マレーシア、インドネシア、ブラジルへの先端半導体の出荷に米国の輸出許可を義務付ける規則に続くものとなる。

また、上院民主党のシューマー院内総務は２３日、民主党が来年１月に議会の主導権を握った際には、フアン氏やエヌビディアの他の幹部、そしてトランプ政権を調査すると表明した。 

フアン氏は１２月３日の上院銀行委員会の公聴会で証言する予定で、早くも自身の政治的影響力を試されることになる。

さらに、エヌビディア社内にも変化が見られる。同社は先週、中国への高性能人工知能（ＡＩ）半導体の出荷を停止したと明らかにした。同社はまた、輸出管理の順守状況や国家安全保障上のリスクを監督するため、独立取締役からなる委員会も設置した。 

北京を拠点とするアンクラ・コンサルティングのマネージング・ディレクター、アルフレド・モントゥファル・ヘル氏は、フアン氏が中国で人気があり、米中双方の指導部との接点も持っていることから、同氏の復帰は二国間関係にとってプラスになると述べた。

ただ、トランプ氏が中国政府と結んだ貿易休戦に批判的な次期議会は、半導体規制の強化を推し進める可能性が高いと指摘。「こうした監視の強化は、中国での米テック企業の事業活動を複雑化させ、最終的にフアン氏が果たし得る架け橋としての役割を制約することになるだろう」との見方を示した。

Nov 24 : Millwall became the first club in the English Football League to receive a partial stadium closure for discriminatory chanting after being found guilty of misconduct linked to incidents during January's match against Charlton Athletic, the Football Association (FA) said on Tuesday.
• The Championship side have been issued to reduce capacity for their December 8 match against Sheffield United, while a second partial stadium closure has been suspended until the end of the 2027-28 season.
• Millwall were also fined 70,000 pounds ($91,000), ordered to pay hearing costs and warned about their future conduct.
• The charges related to chants deemed discriminatory on the grounds of disability and sexual orientation.

items.title: フーシ派がリヤド最高層ビル攻撃、11人負傷　1週間足らずで2度目
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２４日 ロイター] - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派が２４日、サウジアラビアの首都リヤドで最も高いビルを攻撃し、少なくとも１１人が負傷した。同じビルへの攻撃は１週間足らずで２度目。フーシ派の攻撃は湾岸最大の経済国であるサウジに混乱をもたらしている。

サウジの民間防衛当局が負傷者の発生を報告し、政府系ファンドのパブリック・インベストメント・ファンド（ＰＩＦ）の本部が入居する同ビルの写真を公開した。写真では建物の外壁の中ほどに損傷が見られ、１９日に同じビルが攻撃された際の被害と似ていた。１９日の攻撃では建物に被害が出たが、負傷者はいなかった。

ロイターは写真の撮影時期や、今回の攻撃で新たに生じた被害の程度を直ちに確認できなかった。

フーシ派と戦うサウジアラビア主導の有志連合は２４日、サウジの首都リヤドの金融街にある超高層ビルが「テロ攻撃」の標的になったと発表した。

フーシ派による一連の攻撃でリヤド発着の国際線の大半が欠航となり、サウジはサッカーのアジアカップなど主要な国際イベントの延期や中止を余儀なくされている。

フーシ派はイエメンの首都サヌアを含むイエメン西部の大半を掌握しており、サウジの空港や石油インフラへの攻撃を継続。今月に入り、国営石油会社サウジアラムコのリヤドにある建物も攻撃された。

items.title: 中国、対米通商「休戦」2カ月延長　重要鉱物の禁輸停止を継続
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [北京 ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[北京 ２４日 ロイター] - 中国商務省は２４日、重要鉱物の事実上の対米禁輸措置の停止を来年１月２７日まで延長すると発表した。禁輸措置の停止は２０２６年１１月２７日に失効する予定だった。

対象となるのは、ガリウム、ゲルマニウム、アンチモン、超硬度材料に関連するデュアルユース（軍民両用）品目。さらに、グラファイト（黒鉛）に関するエンドユーザーと最終用途のより厳格な審査が含まれる。

今回の発表は、ここ数週間に相次いだ同様の延長措置に続くもので、これにより中国政府と米政府の通商面での「休戦」は事実上２カ月延びることになる。

中国はこれらの重要鉱物の輸出を２０２３年８月から２４年９月まで制限した後、米国が中国の半導体産業に課した規制への対抗措置として、２４年１２月に米国への全面的な禁輸に踏み切った。

この禁輸措置により米国内で供給不足が生じ、一部の輸入業者はこれらの素材を入手するため、第三国を経由して出荷するなどの回避策を取った。

items.author: ロイター

items.body:
[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - 米連邦住宅金融庁（ＦＨＦＡ）が２４日発表した９月の米住宅価格指数（季節調整済み）は前月比で横ばいとなった。住宅ローン金利の上昇により需要が鈍化したことが背景にある。ただ、供給不足により価格の広範な下落は回避できる公算が大きい。 

８月の前月比は当初の０．３％上昇から０．２％上昇に下方改定された。

９月は前年同月比では２．５％上昇と、８月の２．４％から伸びが拡大した。

第３・四半期では０．７％上昇し、第２・四半期の０．４％上昇から伸びが拡大した。第３・四半期は前年同期比では２．５％上昇した。

地域別では、９地域のうち５地域が上昇。ニューイングランド地域が０．８％、南大西洋地域が０．７％それぞれ上昇した。一方、太平洋地域は０．８％下落。西北中部、西南中部、東南中部の各地域でも価格が下落した。

前年同月比では、９地域のうち８地域で価格が上昇し、中部大西洋地域は４．３％上昇と大幅に伸びた。一方、太平洋地域は０．４％下落した。

FAST

Nov 24 : Nvidia shares fell on Tuesday as the historic rally sparked by Jensen Huang's return as CEO quickly lost steam, with investors refocusing on the political and governance risks surrounding his reinstatement.
Shares of the AI chipmaker were down more than 7 per cent after surging 31.5 per cent on Monday and adding more than $952 billion in market value. Other AI stocks also slipped after rallying in the previous session.
Under pressure from US President Donald Trump, Nvidia brought back Huang after his resignation over revelations of extramarital affairs, capping a whirlwind period that roiled markets and unsettled the AI ecosystem reliant on the chipmaker's technology and funding.
Huang addressed employees during an all-hands meeting at the company's headquarters on Tuesday, according to media reports, a day after returning to the top job.

"The reinstatement itself raises as many questions as it answers. His return removes a major uncertainty, but what it leaves behind is an overhang on how Nvidia's governance is viewed," said Dan Sheehan, director of portfolio management at Telos Wealth Advisors.
"There are also questions ... about how involved the government will be in Nvidia going forward, and about governance of conduct internally given the stance the reinstatement implicitly took. Those don't get resolved by a soaring stock price."
US lawmakers from both parties sharply criticized Nvidia's decision, saying Congress should scrutinize the circumstances surrounding Huang's return.
UNDER THE SCANNER
Both Huang and the company are facing a host of state and federal probes and reviews, including those from the FBI, the Justice Department and the US Securities and Exchange Commission.
A public Senate hearing is set for December 3, where Huang is due to testify, while the board's own investigations into potential foreign intelligence efforts, national security and export controls are still underway.
"Now that the dust is beginning to settle, people are taking a more critical look at (Nvidia's) decision ... They (board) put themselves at a tremendous ethical and legal risk by the decision they made," said Peter Andersen, founder of Andersen Capital Management.
He added that Huang's upcoming testimony is also an "enormous risk to the company."
Monday's surge propelled Nvidia back into second place among the world's most valuable companies, behind Apple, though the stock remains almost 31 per cent below its October 6 record high.
AI-related companies, including chipmakers and data-center stocks, saw sharp gains too, while the benchmark S&P 500 added more than $2.8 trillion in market value.
"As incredible as Monday was, I don't take it as a sign we're out of the woods ... a market that can rise $3 trillion on one headline can fall just as fast on another," Telos' Sheehan said.

Source: Reuters

FAST

Nov 24 : Nvidia shares fell on Tuesday as the historic rally sparked by Jensen Huang's return as CEO quickly lost steam, with investors refocusing on the political and governance risks surrounding his reinstatement.
Shares of the AI chipmaker were down more than 7 per cent after surging 31.5 per cent on Monday and adding more than $952 billion in market value. Other AI stocks also slipped after rallying in the previous session.
Under pressure from US President Donald Trump, Nvidia brought back Huang after his resignation over revelations of extramarital affairs, capping a whirlwind period that roiled markets and unsettled the AI ecosystem reliant on the chipmaker's technology and funding.
Huang addressed employees during an all-hands meeting at the company's headquarters on Tuesday, according to media reports, a day after returning to the top job.

"The reinstatement itself raises as many questions as it answers. His return removes a major uncertainty, but what it leaves behind is an overhang on how Nvidia's governance is viewed," said Dan Sheehan, director of portfolio management at Telos Wealth Advisors.
"There are also questions ... about how involved the government will be in Nvidia going forward, and about governance of conduct internally given the stance the reinstatement implicitly took. Those don't get resolved by a soaring stock price."
US lawmakers from both parties sharply criticized Nvidia's decision, saying Congress should scrutinize the circumstances surrounding Huang's return.
UNDER THE SCANNER
Both Huang and the company are facing a host of state and federal probes and reviews, including those from the FBI, the Justice Department and the US Securities and Exchange Commission.
A public Senate hearing is set for December 3, where Huang is due to testify, while the board's own investigations into potential foreign intelligence efforts, national security and export controls are still underway.
"Now that the dust is beginning to settle, people are taking a more critical look at (Nvidia's) decision ... They (board) put themselves at a tremendous ethical and legal risk by the decision they made," said Peter Andersen, founder of Andersen Capital Management.
He added that Huang's upcoming testimony is also an "enormous risk to the company."
Monday's surge propelled Nvidia back into second place among the world's most valuable companies, behind Apple, though the stock remains almost 31 per cent below its October 6 record high.
AI-related companies, including chipmakers and data-center stocks, saw sharp gains too, while the benchmark S&P 500 added more than $2.8 trillion in market value.
"As incredible as Monday was, I don't take it as a sign we're out of the woods ... a market that can rise $3 trillion on one headline can fall just as fast on another," Telos' Sheehan said.

Source: Reuters

By Karen Brettell
NEW YORK, Nov 24 : The dollar slipped on Tuesday, giving back much of Monday's gains, as a sharp rally in AI stocks sparked by Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia's CEO faded, and traders questioned whether the greenback had climbed too far, too fast.
The US currency has been supported by bets that the Federal Reserve will keep raising interest rates, since growth remains strong and inflation is still stubbornly above the Fed's 2 per cent target.

Still, "the US growth edge over the Eurozone, UK, and Japan narrowed further in November," which could weigh on the dollar, said Elias Haddad, global head of markets strategy at Brown Brothers Harriman.
Fed funds futures traders are pricing in 98 per cent odds of a Fed hike in December, and a 66 per cent chance of an additional increase in January, according to the CME Group's FedWatch Tool. 
Huang's reinstatement on Monday gave equities some relief, but some analysts are questioning how long it will last. 
Recent stock market wobbles have raised questions about how far the Fed can tighten without hurting the economy. The AI trade has lifted the dollar by drawing capital into the US and raising growth expectations. The dollar also tends to act as a safe haven when stocks fall.
The dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies including the yen and the euro, fell 0.52 per cent to 103.76, with the euro up 0.72 per cent at $1.0978.
The single currency was also boosted by data showing that German business morale rose for a seventh straight month in November.
The Japanese yen weakened 0.11 per cent against the greenback to 159.15 per dollar. Sterling strengthened 0.59 per cent to $1.3106.
The Australian dollar strengthened 0.35 per cent to $0.6649, but remained near 11-month lows. In the last month, it has been the worst-performing major currency against the dollar, with a drop of more than 5 per cent as traders price in the prospect of rate cuts.
Analysts at JPMorgan said short positions in the Aussie dollar have "accumulated substantially", with bearish positioning reaching "extreme levels in some cases" by their metrics.
Weekly data from the US markets regulator shows speculators hold their largest bearish position in the Aussie on record, worth some $12.25 billion, according to LSEG calculations.
"Looking first at options, AUD puts have been outnumbering calls for several months now. Early in this process, it seemed reasonable to assume that this might simply be macro hedging, rather than actual outright directional positioning. But the flows have probably migrated to the latter of late," JPMorgan said. 
In cryptocurrencies, bitcoin fell 1.69 per cent to $60,255.
(Additional reporting by Amanda Cooper and Rae Wee, editing by Deepa Babington)

Source: Reuters

items.title: 米国防省、ドローン量産へＧＭ・フォードなどと協議＝報道
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２４日 ロイター] - 米国防総省がドローン（無人機）の量産化に向け、米自動車大手ゼネラル・モーターズ（ＧM）とフォードや他の製造大手などと協議していることが分かった。米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）が２４日、関係者の話として報じた。

報道によると、合意が成立すれば、各社はエンジンやセンサー、ライダー（LiDAR、センサー技術）などの部品をドローンメーカーに供給することになる。

ＧＭは国防総省当局者からの要請を受け、軍事プロジェクトへの参画に最も強い関心を示しており、ドローン用モーターの製造を巡り検討しているという。

当局者らはさらに、フォードやカナダの自動車部品メーカー大手マグナ・インターナショナル などの幹部らと会談した。

しかしアナリストによると、自動車業界は、地政学的紛争を背景に支出が急拡大する防衛分野への参入を試みてきたものの、収益拡大の機会は依然として限られているという。

items.title: ウクライナ戦争、ロシア敗北へ来年が「転機」の可能性＝ラトビア大統領
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Andrea Shalal

[ニューヨーク ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Andrea Shalal

[ニューヨーク ２４日 ロイター] - ラトビアのリンケービッチ大統領は、ロシアのウクライナに対する戦争は来年、ロシアの敗北につながる転機を迎える可能性があるとの見方を示した。ロシア経済の悪化と国際的な圧力の高まりを理由に挙げた。

リンケービッチ氏は２３日、国連安全保障理事会の議長を務めるためニューヨーク訪問中に、ロイターとのインタビューに応じた。同氏は、ロシアが戦争終結に本当に関心を持っているとは思えないとし、停戦に向けた新たな交渉を、全面侵攻を続けるための「おとり」と見なしている可能性が高いと語った。 

ウクライナは、過酷な冬、エネルギー関連施設への攻撃の増加、民間人を狙った攻撃のエスカレートという「最悪の事態の重なり」に直面しているものの、欧州は軍事、財政、インフラ面での支援でウクライナを支える構えであり、ウクライナは強じん性を繰り返し証明してきたと同氏は述べた。

また、「ウクライナが軍事面でも経済面でも持ちこたえていることを確認できれば、転機は来年、来春または来夏になる可能性がある」とし、自身はウクライナは必ず持ちこたえると確信していると語った。

さらに、ロシア経済への圧力に加え、戦争を終結させる必要性について政治的な合意が形成されつつあると指摘。インド人の船員が死亡したり、フィリピンなどの船舶が攻撃を受けたりした事例を挙げ「圧力をかけている国の数が増えつつあるため、転機は来春か来夏に訪れるかもしれない」とし、戦争が近隣地域を越えて拡大していると指摘した。

同氏はまた、欧州諸国を標的とし、ロシアとの関連が疑われる、領空侵犯やサイバー攻撃、破壊工作などの「ハイブリッド活動」の増加について懸念を表明。ロシアはこれまで、北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）の集団防衛を定める北大西洋条約第５条の発動につながるレッドライン（越えてはならない一線）を越えないよう慎重に行動してきたが、次第に大胆になってきていると指摘。 

「現時点で見られる限り、ロシアはこの一線を越えないよう極めて慎重だ。同時に、別の傾向も見られる。ロシア国内でリスクへの意欲が高まっているのだ」と述べ、破壊工作や放火未遂、ウクライナに友好的な団体への攻撃の件数が、ロシアによる２０２２年の全面侵攻開始以降、急増していると指摘した。

WASHINGTON, Nov 24 : A quasar, one of the universe's most energetic and luminous objects, is the enormously bright core of a galaxy, powered by a central supermassive black hole. Astronomers have now found the oldest-known quasar, one that formed so early in cosmic history that they are still trying to decipher how it happened.
They identified a quasar dating to more than 13.1 billion years ago when the cosmos was less than 5 per cent of its current age, some 630 million years after the Big Bang event that initiated the universe. The quasar dates to 40 million years earlier than the previous record holder, disclosed in July.
"I think it adds to the evidence that some objects in the early universe developed remarkably quickly. Just 630 million years after the Big Bang, this black hole had already grown to about 360 million times the mass of the sun and was shining as a quasar," said astronomer Julien Wolf of the European Southern Observatory in Germany, lead author of the research published in the journal Astronomy and Astrophysics.
Black holes are extraordinarily dense objects with gravity so strong that not even light can escape.

The quasar was first detected by the European Space Agency's Euclid orbiting telescope and then further characterized using a combination of ground- and space-based telescopes.
The researchers gave the quasar the nickname Dún Aonghasa, the name of an ancient stone fort in Ireland that is perched atop a cliff overlooking the vast expanse of the Atlantic Ocean.
A supermassive black hole that powers a quasar is typically billions of times more massive than the sun.
"As enormous amounts of gas, dust and matter fall toward the black hole, they form a swirling accretion disk that heats up to extreme temperatures and radiates tremendous amounts of energy, outshining the entire rest of the galaxy by factors of hundreds or even thousands," said astronomer and study co-author Silvia Belladitta of the Max Planck Institute for Astronomy in Germany and the INAF Bologna Observatory of Astrophysics and Space Science in Italy.
"This makes quasars visible across billions of light-years, allowing us to observe them from the very early universe. Studying quasars helps astronomers understand how the first galaxies formed and evolved, and how the supermassive black holes at their hearts grew to such enormous sizes," Belladitta said.
The Dún Aonghasa supermassive black hole is about 90 times more massive than the one at the center of our Milky Way.
A TRANSFORMATIVE EPOCH
It dates to one of the universe's most dramatic and transformative epochs. After the Big Bang, the cosmos cooled into a dark and neutral fog of hydrogen gas. The first stars and galaxies then began to ignite, and their intense radiation slowly burned through the fog, making the universe transparent to light for the first time.
"This process was still unfolding at the time this quasar and its host galaxy were forming. It is a remarkable epoch to find such an object. The supermassive black hole powering this quasar had already grown to an enormous mass in an extremely short time, which challenges our understanding of how black holes can grow so large so quickly in the early universe," Belladitta said.
One possibility is that this black hole started out small after the demise of a star that was part of the first stellar generation, but the observations indicated it was consuming material at a rate too slow to have achieved its great mass so quickly. Another possibility is that it may have been born big in a formation scenario called direct collapse.
"Normally, a large cloud of gas cools and breaks up into smaller clumps that form stars. Under the right conditions, the gas could stay warm enough to limit that fragmentation, allowing much of it to flow towards the center. That gas can build up a single enormous star that quickly collapses into a black hole. That black hole would start out far more massive than the remnant of a typical first-generation star," Wolf said.
The researchers said Euclid may yet spot quasars at farther distances — meaning older — than Dún Aonghasa, with theoretical models suggesting that the first quasars could potentially date to 270 million to 470 million years post-Big Bang.
"So in short: this is the furthest quasar we have ever seen, but maybe not the furthest there is to find," Belladitta said.

Source: Reuters

APL Apollo will first buy Tata Steel’s tubes & colour business (TSCL) for ₹28,000 crore. Then Tata Steel will buy APL Apollo for about ₹32,267 crore in a transaction that includes buying out the latter’s promoters and an open offer. It implies about ₹4,200 crore in new liabilities for Tata Steel.

FAST

LONDON, Nov 24 : The BBC will make a selection of its CBeebies children's programmes available on Netflix in Britain from December 2, as the publicly funded broadcaster explores new ways of reaching audiences through commercial streaming platforms.
• The limited trial will feature a CBeebies-branded hub on Netflix, offering a selection of programmes such as "Hey Duggee" and "Teletubbies", the BBC said
• The British broadcaster, which is funded by a licence fee paid by TV-watching households, said iPlayer, its own streaming platform, would remain the home of the full CBeebies experience
• Netflix has committed to funding a small number of new CBeebies commissions, the BBC said

• The trial comes as UK-made children's programming faces growing competition from international streaming platforms and YouTube, which have transformed how younger audiences consume content
• The partnership will also extend globally, making selected CBeebies content available to Netflix members outside Britain in a distribution deal managed by BBC Studios, the BBC's commercial arm
• BBC's Chief Content Officer Kate Phillips said: "It's an opportunity to learn more about how partnerships can help us extend the reach of our content."
• Netflix said the collaboration would give parents access to more CBeebies favourites on the platform

FAST

Nov 24 : Shares of Hewlett Packard Enterprise fell about 12 per cent in premarket trading on Tuesday, giving back part of the previous session's surge, as investors focused on margin pressure despite a sharply raised fiscal 2027 outlook.
The stock had jumped about 17 per cent on Monday and more than doubled this year through the close, but is set to lose more than $7 billion in market value if premarket losses hold.
• The downbeat reaction comes even as the company on Monday reported fourth-quarter adjusted earnings of $1.43 per share, above analysts' average estimate of $1.29, according to data compiled by LSEG
• It raised its fiscal 2027 revenue growth forecast to a range of 27 per cent to 35 per cent, from previous forecast of 13 per cent to 17 per cent

• Cloud & AI operating margin is forecast to fall to about 14 per cent in fiscal 2027, making margin mix the key debate for investors, according to JPMorgan analysts
• The average rating of the 24 analysts covering the stock is "buy", and their median price target is $67.24, according to LSEG data

FAST

Nov 24 : Spotify was back online on Tuesday after the music streaming service was down briefly for thousands of US users earlier in the day, according to outage tracking website Downdetector.com.
User reports peaked at more than 14,000 at around 6:45 a.m. ET, according to Downdetector, which tracks outages by collating status reports from a number of sources. Reports had fallen sharply to about 600 as of 7:17 a.m. ET.
Downdetector's numbers are based on user-submitted reports. The actual number of affected users may vary.
Spotify said on X it was aware of "some issues" and was looking into it, and later added, "Everything's looking much better now."

Tech outages have become an increasingly important area of focus for governments, companies and the public in recent months as sophisticated AI tools make it easier to discover vulnerabilities and attack systems.
A string of technology failures this month disrupted critical US systems, including a nationwide halt to air travel, a Microsoft outage that hit email services, a technical glitch that affected several major banks and a temporary disruption to the National Security Agency's network.

FAST

Nov 24 : Best Buy raised its annual comparable sales growth target on Tuesday, betting on robust demand during the holiday shopping season as customers spend on new AI-enabled phones and TVs as well as wearable technology such as smart glasses.
"We're seeing the emerging categories bucket ... health rings, AI glasses, and trading cards and collectibles are driving about a full point of comp (comparable sales growth) for us," CEO Jason Bonfig told Reuters.
Affluent consumers have been splurging on pricier nice-to-have products across categories from dual-screen phones to Coach handbags, as they lock in gains from stock market portfolios and investments in assets such as real estate.
In contrast, lower- and middle-income consumers have sharply pulled back spending, with inflation and high gas prices crimping budgets, exacerbating a K-shaped effect among US consumers this year.
