Consumers have also been upgrading their phones, laptops and other gadgets for AI-enabled options, often at higher price points, driving an upgrade cycle for the electronics retailer.
Best Buy said it saw "significant strength" in its business above the $1,500 price point in the three months through October, when total comparable sales jumped 6.1 per cent and handily beat estimates of 2.3 per cent growth.
The company was working within its supply chain to dull the hit from higher fuel costs, said Bonfig, who took over as CEO earlier this month.
Retailers across the board have warned of higher freight costs this year as the US war on Iran drags up oil prices.
Best Buy now expects annual comparable sales to rise between 3.4 per cent and 4 per cent, compared with its earlier target of 1.9 per cent to 3 per cent growth. Its stock rose about 2 per cent in morning trading.
Comparable sales growth driven by computing and phones is a positive sign for electronics at Walmart, Target and Costco heading into the holiday shopping season, said Stifel analyst Michael Montani.
Higher memory chip costs have driven up product prices, but computing demand remained resilient, Best Buy executives said on a post-earnings call.
Trade-ins on older products, credit card financing options and some promotions were levers Best Buy was pulling to support sales in the category, executives added.
Best Buy's total revenue rose 5.8 per cent to $10.24 billion in the third quarter, beating estimates of $9.90 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG.
As customers prepared for the launch of "Grand Theft Auto VI", the much-awaited installment in Take-Two Interactive's flagship franchise, Best Buy saw growth in gaming hardware and accessories in the third quarter, Bonfig said.
The company raised its fiscal 2027 adjusted earnings per share target to between $6.90 and $7.05, after quarterly adjusted earnings of $1.62 per share topped estimates.

items.title: 対イスラエル年38億ドル軍事支援、年内終了は不確実＝米大使
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Alexander Cornwell

[テルアビブ ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Alexander Cornwell

[テルアビブ ２４日 ロイター] - 米国のハッカビー駐イスラエル大使は、今月の中間選挙当日にトランプ米大統領が約束した、イスラエルへの年間３８億ドルの軍事支援を今年末までに打ち切るという方針について、その実現に疑問を呈した。

トランプ氏は１１月３日、数カ月前にイスラエルのネタニヤフ首相と、イスラエルへの年間約４０億ドルの米国資金提供を停止することで合意していたと突如発表した。

トランプ氏は詳細を明かさず、資金提供をどのように停止するかも説明しなかった。米国はイスラエルと、２０２８年まで年間３８億ドルを供与し、米国製軍事装備の購入資金に充てるという覚書を結んでいる。

２４日にテルアビブで開催された米イスラエル関係に関する会議で放映された事前収録のインタビューで、ハッカビー氏は「（覚書は）あと２年間継続する予定であるため、今年末までに突然停止されるかどうかは定かではない」と説明。資金は議会によってすでに割り当てられており、議会の承認なしにこれを停止できるかどうかは分からないと述べた。

items.title: エヌビディア取締役会の独立性に疑問の声、調査完了前にＣＥＯ復帰
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Ross Kerber　Echo Wang

[ボストン／ニューヨーク ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Ross Kerber　Echo Wang

[ボストン／ニューヨーク ２４日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアの取締役会は、ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の行動に関する調査が終わる前に同氏を復帰させた。この結果、自ら主張する独立性への信頼を損なったと投資家や企業統治の専門家が批判している。

ニューヨーク市のマーク・レバイン会計検査官は、今回の事態で取締役会の立場が損なわれたと述べた。同氏はエヌビディア株約５００万株を保有する退職年金基金の運用に携わっている。

「取締役会はフアン氏が戻ることはないとわれわれに断言していた。それなのに何の説明もなく、法的責任などへの懸念が解消されたことも示さないまま方針を１８０度転換した」と批判した。「取締役会は独立していないことを自ら証明した。独立性こそあらゆる取締役会に不可欠な資質だ」と述べた。

米運用会社ファンエックのヤン・ファンエックＣＥＯは「議会公聴会など、政府・議会でさらに手続きを踏むため、判断にはもっと時間がかかると予想していた。だが政権はこれ以上悪い事実が出てこないことに賭けるつもりなのだろう」と述べた。

＜誠実さへの疑問＞

エヌビディアの取締役会は、フアン氏の復帰が国家安全保障上のリスクをもたらさないとしたほか、協議の結果、「フアン氏の誠実さとエヌビディアを率いる能力について納得した」と説明した。

英レディング大学ヘンリー・ビジネス・スクールのナダ・カカバゼ教授は、声明には説明の足りない部分があると話した。「フアン氏が会社に何を伝えたかについて調査が続いているのに、『誠実さに納得した』というのは奇妙な言い回しだ。取締役会は証拠がそろう前に結論を出している」と述べた。

取締役会は会社の裁量の余地の多くを手放したと指摘。「取締役会の判断を国家に委ねることになる。エヌビディアに輸出許可を出す政府が、今や同社のＣＥＯを事実上保証している。これでは同社が政治に依存することになり、将来の政権が支持を撤回する可能性もある」と述べた。

エヌビディアのハーベイ・ジョーンズ取締役が会長に就いたのは今月に入ってからだ。調査会社エクイラーによると、それまでエヌビディアは、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種の構成企業で取締役会議長がいない２社のうちの１社だった。企業統治の専門家はこうした体制に加え、在任期間の長い取締役が多いことから、取締役会は独立して行動できると示す必要があると以前から指摘していた。

モーニングスターの機関投資家インサイト担当ディレクターのリンジー・スチュワート氏は、フアン氏の復帰への安堵が広がる一方、「世界的に極めて重要なＡＩエコシステムの中心にあり、今や巨大企業となったエヌビディアで、適切な企業統治と主要リスクの監督を担うのに誰が最もふさわしいのか必ず疑問が出る」と述べた。取締役会はこうした疑問に答えないままフアン氏を再任したと話した。

＜大株主の支持にも疑問＞

ハーバード大ロースクールのルシアン・ベブチャク教授は、名目上は会社の所有者であるエヌビディアの大株主から、取締役会が支持を取り付けた形跡はないと述べた。同氏はトランプ大統領が任命した規制当局者らが最近導入した政策により、大手運用会社が企業統治の問題に意見を述べにくくなっていると指摘した。

フアン氏が今後、国家安全保障上のリスクをもたらさないとしても、これまでの行動により、同氏と会社が多額の費用を伴う調査に巻き込まれる可能性はなおあるとの見方を示した。「発表直後に株価が上昇したことで、取締役会は自らの判断が正しかったと受け止めているのだろう。しかし以前の決定を覆したことには重大な疑問と懸念がある」と語った。

WASHINGTON, Nov 24 : Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh has called artificial intelligence a "hinge" of history critical to US leadership, but the technology has also become key to Fed policy as officials debate whether the AI boom is a transformational moment, a source of inflation, or the harbinger of an economic meltdown. 
For Warsh, who calls himself "cautiously optimistic" about what he refers to as "super intelligence," as President Donald Trump does, it may be an all-of-the-above dilemma that challenges the US central bank and his leadership of it.
"This is a serious test for Warsh," Evercore ISI Vice Chairman Krishna Guha, a former New York Fed official, wrote after major US equity indexes closed last week in correction territory. They were dragged down by nervousness about AI's ability to pay off and by unease over the scandal around AI chip giant Nvidia and the brief ouster of its CEO.
Recent inflation and growth data "is too hot and too strong ... But with growth dependent on AI investment and AI consumer net-worth effects, the Fed needs any weakening to remain contained," Guha wrote. "Warsh needs to balance the data with markets that suggest the forward look is cooler, and his desire to assert inflation credibility with his desire not to go down in history as the Fed chair who blew up the AI boom."

After a run that saw a political backlash against AI, a market slump, a major initial public offering, a massive corporate scandal, and a seeming rebound from it all with equity markets again surging, Fed officials are expected to follow through with a quarter-percentage-point rate increase at their December 8-9 meeting. While they do not necessarily aim to — or have any guarantee they can — slow the AI boom, many see it pushing growth beyond potential and see the need to restrain some aspects of investment and demand.
"If the investment rate slows way down, then yes, I'd be less concerned that there would be overheating in the economy," Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee told reporters last week, likening the strain AI puts on capacity to trying to get a "pig through the python."
But the impact of rate hikes on the economy "doesn't have to be sector by sector," he said. "The Fed has only one tool, which is to tighten rates ... I do think data centers are included in that business investment" and might be influenced by rising borrowing costs.
'VERY TROUBLING SIGN'
Some US central bank officials have recently discussed AI.
Fed Governor Lisa Cook noted possible financial risks and the likelihood that AI is already eliminating jobs, and Fed Vice Chair Philip Jefferson said AI investment is currently raising inflation, with any productivity benefits still to come.
Warsh, who before taking over as Fed chief had cautioned central bankers to avoid taking sides on political issues like climate change, has called success in AI a make-or-break issue for the US. 
"We are at a hinge point for the US economy, the United States' role in the world," Warsh said last week at an AI conference he commissioned, held at the San Francisco Fed. "I don't think any of us are impartial to how we want that to come out." 
Increasingly, however, Warsh's colleagues see a more nuanced debate and are focused on near-term implications.
The volatility has been apparent: Nvidia reversed course and rehired Jensen Huang as its chief executive officer on Monday, and stocks surged back after recent sharp losses.
Politically, the country has become more divided, too, about how to balance AI's benefits and risks, the pace of construction, and concerns that the technology is moving too fast without proper oversight.
"People are afraid. When the average American hears AI, they hear I'll lose my job, my kids will lose their jobs, my children's mental health, national security, some version of that," former US Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo said on a panel with Warsh at his AI conference. 
Raimondo, who currently co-chairs a nonprofit trying to ease the AI transition for workers, noted that many ballot initiatives meant to slow data-center construction were approved by voters during the recent US midterm elections.
"I think that is a very troubling sign," she said. "When people are afraid they say 'stop.' I think that would be very bad for America and for them. So where I think we have to go from here is to figure out how we address people's legitimate concerns."
WARSH 'BROUGHT THIS REVOLT ON HIMSELF'
The Fed's role, as Warsh likes to note, is not to pick winners and losers but to guide the credit conditions in which all firms operate, in ways that affect inflation.
Fed officials' view of AI investment as a source of inflation has put the Fed at direct odds with Trump, who wants the boom to roll on. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and other administration officials say rising prices are primarily the fault of still-high global oil prices that will fade as energy costs ease. 
Warsh, who has defined his chairmanship partly by avoiding guidance on upcoming policy decisions, has acknowledged that AI "hits demand first," with supply and productivity improvements coming later and possibly helping ease inflation down the road.
But he has not yet made the same leap as others and has avoided commenting on whether he feels the AI boom and inflation are now running hand in hand, and on how the Fed may need to respond.
That question has become a key issue ahead of the next policy meeting, when policymakers are due to update their interest rate projections after a period in which the rhetoric of many of them leaned hawkish even as the election results, stock markets and other dynamics pointed to a possible slowdown.
The problem for markets since the midterm elections "has not been just the prospect of an AI slowdown. It's also been that the Fed has seemingly ignored the risks and uncertainty that the post-election period has brought, and thrown caution to the wind," Macquarie analysts wrote recently. "In a way, Warsh has brought this revolt on himself, by not abandoning his own aversion to expressing forward guidance," even as the debate around what he sees as the signature economic issue of the day has become more complex.

Source: Reuters

BERLIN, Nov 24 : German Economy Minister Katherina Reiche urged industry on Tuesday to make use of artificial intelligence, while a business group said an investment-friendly climate was needed.
• "Germany has the potential to be at the forefront again in the next technological leap," Reiche said in a press release. "Our industry has knowledge and production data that can hardly be copied."

• Peter Leibinger, president of the BDI industry association, said at an industry conference in Berlin that the situation was serious despite some bright spots.

Anthropic falls below US$83 IPO price in swift reversal after record listing

This extends a steep retreat from its US$111.50 opening price on Nov 19.

FAST

Anthropic's shares slipped below their US$83 initial public offering price in premarket trading on Tuesday (Nov 24), a striking unraveling just days after the Claude developer's record-breaking Nasdaq debut.
After briefly breaking below its offer price, the stock was last down 5 per cent at US$83.39, extending a steep retreat from its US$111.50 opening price on Nov 19.
Anthropic missed out on a broad Wall Street rally driven by AI-related stocks after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive on Monday.
The stock debuted 34 per cent above the IPO price but has since been swept up in a broader technology selloff, with the S&P 500 and the Dow ending the previous week in confirmed correction territory.

Anthropic's rapid reversal has added to concerns about stretched AI valuations and the vast sums being poured into computing infrastructure, with rising interest rates threatening to push those costs even higher. As the first frontier AI company to go public, Anthropic is widely seen as a proxy for the sector.
"If we do see a slowdown in the data-centre buildout, then that obviously can impact the speed at which Anthropic can develop and therefore future revenue and therefore its valuation," said Fiona Cincotta, senior market analyst at StoneX.
Anthropic is not alone among blockbuster technology IPOs in quickly surrendering early gains and falling below its offer price. SpaceX, whose US$85.7 billion June listing was the world's biggest before Anthropic, took about a month to fall below its offer price.
In 2012, Facebook, now Meta Platforms, had slipped below its offer price on its second trading day.
The comparisons show that a swift loss of an IPO premium is not unprecedented even for highly anticipated listings, and that an early break below the offer price is not necessarily a guide to longer-term performance.

Related:

Anthropic IPO fails to calm AI jitters as tech stocks plummet

Commentary: Was Anthropic’s record US$81 billion listing a vote of confidence in AI?

KEY RISKS With Anthropic's shares now testing their IPO price, attention is turning to risks that could determine where the stock goes next, including insider selling, pressure from open-weight models and a potential slowdown in data-centre investments.
Anthropic's IPO lock-up provisions allow certain employees and insiders to sell portions of their holdings from the first trading day, with further staggered releases tied to earnings announcements.
CEO Dario Amodei and President Daniela Amodei sold more than 3.37 million shares worth over US$280 million each to the IPO's underwriters a day after the debut, according to a filing late on Monday.
Anthropic's underwriters also exercised their option to buy additional shares, lifting the IPO's gross proceeds to a record US$93.5 billion, while removing a potential source of support for the stock after its debut.
Anthropic also faces growing competition from cheaper open-weight AI models, which it has warned could pressure pricing.
Users can download and adapt models from DeepSeek, Mistral and Moonshot AI, unlike proprietary models such as Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini, with Chinese developers in particular gaining ground globally.
Huang's return could also sharpen the competitive threat to Anthropic, given his strong advocacy for open-weight AI models.
Some support could emerge in the coming days as Anthropic's addition to major indexes prompts buying from passive funds.
Index rebalance analytics firm Intropic estimates passive funds could buy up to 30 per cent of the shares offered by the year-end. MSCI will add Anthropic to its global standard indexes as of the Nov 30 close.

Source: Reuters/dy

items.body:
Shi Bu　Alessandro Diviggiano

[中国・酒泉 ２４日 ロイター] - 中国の宇宙ステーション「天宮」に向けて宇宙船「神舟２４号」が２５日に打ち上げられる。宇宙飛行士のジーシャン・アリ氏（４０）はパキスタン人として初めて地球周回軌道に入り、外国人として初めて天宮に搭乗する予定だ。

アリ氏は天宮に５─１０日間滞在し実験を行う。飛行に備え北京で７カ月間の訓練を受けた。中国語の集中授業を受け、中国の歌や詩を学び、書道や卓球にも取り組んだという。

香港を拠点とするオービタル・ゲートウェイ・コンサルティング創業者のブレイン・カーシオ氏は「（パキスタンにとって）国の威信が高まり、科学技術の重要なノウハウが得られる。中国との協力が深まり、外交上の友好関係も強まる」と述べた。

神舟２４号は中国北西部の酒泉衛星発射センターから、ロケット「長征２Ｆ」で午前８時１８分（日本時間午前９時１８分）に打ち上げられる予定だ。

中国が独自に建設した天宮は２０２２年後半から本格的に運用されている。

Nvidia board's Huang reversal raises doubts about independence, critics say

FAST

BOSTON/NEW YORK, Nov 24 : Nvidia's board undermined its claims of independence by reinstating CEO Jensen Huang before investigations into his conduct concluded, investors and corporate governance experts said on Monday.
The decision is striking because the board effectively vouched for Huang's candor and fitness to lead the company before its own investigation was complete, raising doubts about whether directors had sufficient information to make an independent judgment, these people said.
Nvidia said on Monday that after talks with senior US officials, its board "is confident that Mr. Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk."
Huang resigned on November 12 after reports of extramarital affairs, including one involving a suspected Chinese spy.

The abrupt U-turn, just days after the board vowed to look elsewhere for a successor, has also drawn US President Donald Trump and his administration into Nvidia’s corporate governance. Nvidia shares closed 31.5 per cent higher on Monday even as it was becoming clear that the chipmaker's board acted under pressure from Trump and others, and the president took credit for the change.
Nvidia faces investigations, including by the US Securities and Exchange Commission and the Justice Department, over issues ranging from its accounting to alleged chip smuggling. Nvidia press representatives did not immediately respond to questions for this story.
The situation undercuts the board's standing, said New York City Comptroller Mark Levine, who helps manage retirement funds that hold some 5 million Nvidia shares.
"They told us flatly that he would not be coming back. They have done a total 180 without any explanation, or any indication that concerns about legal and other liabilities have been resolved," Levine said in a telephone interview. 
"They have proven they're not independent, and that is the defining quality that we need from any board," he said.
Jan van Eck, a large Nvidia investor via the investment company bearing his name, said Huang's return likely removes uncertainty but amounts to a bet against further bad headlines.
"I had expected more of a Washington DC process, including Congressional hearings, to lengthen this determination, but I guess the Administration is willing to risk that there are no more bad facts to emerge," van Eck said in an email.   
QUESTIONS OF CANDOR
In addition to saying Huang's return posed no national security risk, Nvidia's board said that after discussions, it was "satisfied with respect to Mr. Huang’s candor and ability to lead NVIDIA."  
The company said an independent board committee is still investigating reports that Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort, and said "the committee’s investigation will proceed to conclusion," with Huang's cooperation. The board has also taken steps like creating a new chief compliance officer position.
Nada Kakabadse, a Henley Business School professor who follows corporate governance, said the statement left gaps. " 'Satisfied with his candor' is a strange phrase while the investigation into what he told the company is still open. The board has reached its verdict before the evidence is in," Kakabadse said. 
Moreover, the board has given away much of the company's room for maneuver, she said. "It hands the board's judgment to the state. The same government that grants Nvidia's export licences now effectively vouches for its CEO. That makes the company politically dependent, and a future administration could withdraw the endorsement," she said.
Nvidia board member Harvey Jones took the title of chair only this month. Until then, Nvidia was one of only two companies in the S&P 500 without a board chair, according to researcher Equilar. 
Corporate governance experts previously had said the setup and the presence of many long-serving directors meant the board would have to show it could act independently.  
Now, alongside relief at Huang's return, "there are sure to be questions about who is best placed to provide appropriate governance and oversight of key risks at the now-giant company at the center of a critically important global AI ecosystem," said Lindsey Stewart, Morningstar director of institutional insights. In reappointing Huang the board left those questions unanswered, Stewart said.
SKEPTICISM FROM SOME LAWMAKERS
US congressional committees will interview Huang on December 1. Lawmakers from both parties expressed skepticism about his return and the role of the administration. Some investors worried the political battles could overshadow Nvidia's commercial story.
"Jensen’s return is not a total shock, but it does send a troubling message about the state of corporate governance in America. Certain executives are going to be held to different standards," said James St. Aubin, chief investment officer of Ocean Park Asset Management in California.  
Harvard Law School Professor Lucian Bebchuk said there was no indication the board had secured the support of Nvidia’s largest shareholders, nominally the owners of the company. (Top fund firms BlackRock and Vanguard did not comment for this story.) 
Bebchuk said recent policies put in place by Trump-appointed regulators make it harder for big fund firms to weigh in on corporate governance issues.
Even if Huang poses no national security risks in the future, his actions to date could still entangle him and the company in costly investigations, Bebchuk said.
"The board presumably feels now vindicated by the immediate stock price increase following this morning’s announcement. However, the board’s reversal of its earlier decision raises serious questions and concerns," Bebchuk said.     

Source: Reuters

LONDON, Nov 24 : Britain's financial watchdog has warned technology and social media companies that AI agents offering financial services could face regulatory action, urging companies to engage early with supervisors.
The statement on Tuesday coincided with Meta's launch of its Muse AI agent into the UK. Muse in the UK can perform tasks such as renewing car insurance, chasing refunds and making online purchases, but it will not initially be able to access bank account statements or provide personalised financial guidance. 
The Financial Conduct Authority did not name any companies in its statement on Tuesday and directed its guidance at companies considering launching agentic products in the UK.
The FCA said that simply describing a business as a technology provider does not make it exempt from financial regulation if products include regulated services such as financial promotions, advice or payment services.

The financial sector is grappling with growing concerns that AI agents could help technology companies to expand into lucrative areas of the industry. Banks have already called on the regulator to scrutinise the use of AI chatbots to deliver financial advice to consumers.
Meta's Muse is one of the fastest-growing apps on record, having clocked up more than 10 million downloads since its September launch in the US.
Unlike the US version, Muse in the UK cannot access users' bank account balances, investment holdings or mortgage information to provide personalised financial guidance or budgeting recommendations, Meta said.
A Meta spokesperson said the company had engaged with the appropriate regulators. 
The social media company wants to connect Muse to UK banking services, but only after speaking to regulators and obtaining any necessary licences to ensure it complies with local laws, the spokesperson added.
In its statement, the FCA also said that consumers who use AI agents should make sure they understand what protections, if any, they have if something goes wrong and what type of information they are sharing and whether it is safe to do so.

items.title: ＥＵ、中国や日本などからのハイブリッド車輸入に一時制限
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Philip Blenkinsop

[ブリュッセル ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Philip Blenkinsop

[ブリュッセル ２４日 ロイター] - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）は域内の自動車メーカーを保護するため、中国、日本、トルコ、英国などからのハイブリッド車輸入に一時的な制限を課した。ただ、ほとんどの国については、既存の出荷分をカバーできるほど十分高い水準に設定されている。

２４日にＥＵ官報で発表されたこの措置は、中国からのハイブリッド車の輸入台数を３５万台に制限するという先月のＥＵ・中国合意を受けたもので、これは今年ＥＵに輸入される予定の台数の約半分に相当する。

１２月１日から適用されるこの数量制限は「セーフガード（緊急輸入制限）」措置で、ＥＵへの主要なハイブリッド車輸出国全てに適用される必要がある。輸入上限が適用されるその他の国は、韓国、メキシコ、モロッコ、セルビア、米国。

この措置は暫定的なもので、調査が続く間、最長２００日間適用される。欧州委員会が調査の結果、より長期にわたり適用される最終措置を提案することになった場合はＥＵ加盟国からの幅広い支持が必要となる。

欧州委は、２０２５年の後半６カ月間および２６年の前半６カ月間の輸入実績を調査の基礎とし、特に中国の輸出に焦点を当てた。

調査期間と比較して、新たな年換算上限をみると、中国に対する輸入上限が最も厳しいものとなっている。

中国商務省は、双方が合意した内容にＥＵが従うことを期待するとともに、中国産業の正当な利益を断固として守るためのあらゆる権利を留保すると述べた。

メキシコ、モロッコ、セルビアからの輸入も、当該期間において上限を超過していた。ただし、メキシコについては超過台数が６００台未満であり、モロッコとセルビアについては、今年の第２・四半期に輸入が著しく減少した。

その他の国々からのＥＵ向けハイブリッド車輸出は、２５年の水準に約１５％を加算した数量制限を下回っていた。

欧州委は、中国からの輸入がＥＵの生産を犠牲にしているだけでなく、日本や韓国などの他の輸出国の市場シェアも侵食していると述べた。

items.title: Sanofi's $41 bn Insmed deal aims to secure growth beyond Dupixent
items.summary: Sanofi's $41 billion acquisition of Insmed will expand its respiratory drug portfolio as the French drugmaker seeks growth beyond blockbuster Dupixent.
items.body:
Home / World News / Sanofi's $41 bn Insmed deal aims to secure growth beyond Dupixent

Sanofi's $41 bn Insmed deal aims to secure growth beyond Dupixent Sanofi's $41 billion acquisition of Insmed will expand its respiratory drug portfolio as the French drugmaker seeks growth beyond blockbuster Dupixent.

Sanofi's $41 billion acquisition of Insmed marks its biggest deal in two decades, strengthening its respiratory drug portfolio as CEO Belen Garijo seeks to reduce the company's reliance on blockbuster Dupixent. (Photo:Reuters)

Reuters 4 min read Last Updated : Nov 24 2026 | 11:15 PM IST

Listen to This Article

Sanofi will buy US drugmaker Insmed for $41 billion in cash, it said on Tuesday, its biggest deal in two decades as CEO Belen Garijo seeks to turn around the French firm and find new sources of growth beyond blockbuster drug Dupixent.
The deal, at a 17.5% premium to Insmed's last closing price, marks a bold bet by Garijo, Sanofi's first female CEO, who took the helm in May with a mandate to fix the company's drug pipeline and arrest a share price slide.
Insmed focuses on respiratory drugs.
"Finally Sanofi is doing the deal everyone expected," said Claus Henrik Johansen, CEO of Global Health Invest, a Danish healthcare investment fund which holds Sanofi shares.
 

"Investors have a glimpse at the 'after-Dupixent' Sanofi," he said, as Sanofi's shares jumped by around 6% on Tuesday.
Also Read

Still, Johansen said more clinical data and sales projections were needed to support the valuation.
Eczema drug Dupixent generated sales of over €15 billion ($16.4 billion) last year, almost 40% of Sanofi's total.
Since taking over, Garijo has launched a strategic review, overhauled the executive committee and expanded a deal with long-time partner Regeneron to settle prior litigation, seen as another win for the CEO.
Sanofi's shares lost ground in Garijo's first few months, but have shot up 20% since the start of October and are now up 12% since she started.

"We are executing with discipline and with vigour," Garijo said.  
SANOFI'S BIGGEST DEAL IN 20 YEARS Sanofi's $175 per share deal for Insmed is 46% above the price on November 18, the day before Bloomberg News first reported Sanofi was weighing a possible acquisition.
The French drugmaker will fund the acquisition through a combination of debt and cash on hand, and has secured committed financing in support of the transaction.
"The deal is the fourth-largest deal in cash in Europe ever, and the first largest in cash in France," Sanofi finance chief François Roger told journalists. JPMorgan was the exclusive financial advisor to Sanofi on the deal, it said.

The transaction is expected to close in the first half of 2027 and to be accretive to earnings per share by the end of 2028, Sanofi said. It estimates annual cost benefits of more than $500 million from the deal, Roger said.
"Insmed is an excellent strategic fit for Sanofi," said Markus Manns, portfolio manager at Sanofi investor Union Investment, adding the deal would help Garijo deal with the Dupixent patent cliff and the weak pipeline.
"Acquiring Insmed would address both objectives."
The deal also follows the appointment of Sanofi's former chief executive, Paul Hudson, to Insmed's board in October.
'IT BUYS TIME' Analysts welcomed the deal, saying Sanofi could fund it without putting its dividend or credit rating at risk.

Sanofi shares were up 6% at €90 by 0915 GMT, the top gainer on Europe's benchmark STOXX 600 index.
Berenberg analyst Luisa Hector said the transaction was a great fit for Sanofi, citing Insmed's respiratory focus, early commercial assets and pipeline. Brokerage Jefferies was more circumspect and said it was not a silver bullet.
"The deal does not fix Sanofi's R&D/pipeline questions, but it buys time," it wrote.
After the acquisition, the combined group expects to generate enough cash to pay down its debt quickly and retain flexibility to invest in early-stage acquisitions.
RESPIRATORY DRUG PIPELINE Insmed has two approved respiratory medicines on the market. Brinsupri treats non-cystic fibrosis bronchiectasis, while Arikayce treats refractory mycobacterium avium complex lung disease.

Garijo said the portfolio offered combined peak sales potential that was expected to exceed $10 billion through the end of the next decade.
"We have a global commercial reach, experience in respiratory diseases, and patient support capabilities to help ensure marketed medicines reach even more patients and realise their full potential," she added.
CFO Roger said Sanofi planned to retain flexibility for bolt-on acquisitions to complement its existing pipeline, particularly for early-stage assets in immunology, rare diseases and vaccines.

items.author: Lakeisha Leo

items.body:

Business

Jensen Huang’s stunning return as Nvidia CEO: A timeline of events

From scandal and resignation to a comeback that sent Nvidia shares soaring 31.5 per cent in a day, CNA traces Jensen Huang’s dramatic fall and rise - and the stock’s wild ride with him.

Jensen Huang gestures as employees applaud his return to office after Nvidia reinstated him as the company's CEO, in Santa Clara, California, US on Nov 23, 2026. (Photo: Nvidia via X/via Reuters)

Lakeisha Leo

Lakeisha Leo

(Updated: 24 Nov 2026 08:42PM)

FAST

Nearly two weeks after Jensen Huang stepped down as chief executive of Nvidia , the Taiwanese-American tech billionaire on Monday (Nov 23) was reinstated as CEO in a stunning comeback .
Huang had stepped down earlier this month following revelations of extramarital affairs, including one with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy . His resignation plunged the chipmaker into crisis and sent shockwaves across an AI industry he helped bankroll.
US stocks surged on Monday , with the Nasdaq jumping more than 6 per cent as Huang’s reinstatement drew investors back to AI-related shares after last week’s rout. Nvidia soared as much as 36.6 per cent after its board announced his return.
Huang’s comeback followed strong public pressure for his reinstatement, including from US President Donald Trump, industry figures such as Tesla CEO Elon Musk and prominent venture capitalists. A petition calling for his reinstatement drew over 180,000 signatures.

In a statement, Huang said that he was honoured to return and "can’t wait to get back to work". 
Videos circulating on social media showed the CEO - wearing a navy jacket instead of his signature black leather jacket - with his hand over his heart, looking up at employees gathered across multiple floors in the building. 
"I’m going to be a better CEO the second time around," he said, amid cheers and applause.

Related:

Wall Street jumps back as Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO

Inside the ‘war room’ that lobbied Donald Trump to bring back Nvidia’s Jensen Huang

Here’s a timeline of how the controversy unfolded and how Nvidia's share price has taken a wild ride with him.
Oct 29: US investigation reported, Huang defends business dealings The New York Times (NYT) reported on Oct 29, 2026, that US authorities had investigated Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang , "who had a close relationship with Jensen Huang" - over suspicions that she had been "passing intelligence to Beijing" and helped circumvent US restrictions on advanced AI chips.
The NYT report stated that US President Trump was "briefed and took no action".
It also raised questions about Alice Huang’s relationship with the Nvidia CEO.
Closing share price: US$213.66, 0.8 per cent down from Oct 28.
Oct 30: Alice Huang suspected of having links to Chinese intelligence The next day, the Wall Street Journal published a report alleging that Alice Huang was suspected of having links to Chinese intelligence.
"Investigators believed the woman, Alice Huang, was recruited based on her relationship with Jensen Huang," the WSJ report said, also attributing concerns to Singapore officials about her relationship with Huang and alleged intelligence connections.
Speaking to Bloomberg News on Oct 30, Huang described Nvidia’s dealings with Singapore-based cloud computing firm Megaspeed as "normal and not unusual" and said that the company had checked that Megaspeed did not illegally divert Nvidia AI chips to China.
"We've studied all their deployments of our GPUs and counted every one," Huang told Bloomberg - also describing his interactions with Alice Huang, who was "no longer with Megaspeed", as typical of those with Chinese customers and executives.
That same day, Beijing rejected the espionage allegations, describing them as "groundless speculation" and an attempt to "smear China".
Closing share price: US$204.64, 4.2 per cent down from Oct 29.
Oct 31: Trump voices support for Huang On Oct 31, a Saturday, Trump voiced his support for Huang in the wake of the NYT report, calling him " brilliant ", adding that Washington was looking "very closely" at the issue.
"I have a lot of respect for Jensen. I didn’t know about the specific thing, but I hope he’s going to be OK. He's a great, brilliant person, and we want to protect our brilliant people," Trump told reporters at his Florida residence.
"We’re going to check it out very closely," he added.
Huang has advised Trump on AI policy and was among the bevy of tech CEOs who joined the US leader on his visit to Beijing in May to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping.

Related:

From affair allegations to Nvidia probe: How the Jensen Huang controversy unfolded

Nvidia probe: Woman in spy scandal entered Taiwan on Hong Kong passport, say authorities

Nov 4 to Nov 5: US lawmakers seek briefing from Nvidia CEO Three senior Republican lawmakers requested a closed-door briefing from Huang over the reported intelligence allegations.
In a letter dated Nov 4, House Foreign Affairs Committee chairman Brian Mast, House Select Committee on China chairman John Moolenaar and House Intelligence Committee chairman Eric Crawford asked Huang to appear before them on Nov 18.
According to Reuters, the lawmakers sought information about the allegations and Nvidia's procedures for protecting sensitive information from foreign intelligence operations.
Nvidia responded that its chief executive regularly meets customers and business leaders worldwide, and that its cloud customers in Asia receive ordinary business information rather than sensitive trade secrets or information affecting US national security.
Closing share price on Nov 5: US$181.60, 9.3 per cent down from Nov 4.
Nov 8: Huang admits his infidelity In a bombshell message to Nvidia employees dropped on a Sunday, Huang admitted that he had been "unfaithful" to his wife , following reports about his alleged relationship with Alice Huang.
Huang wrote that his actions had "hurt her" and their children. "There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry."
He added that he took "full responsibility for what I did and the hurt I caused" and "accepts the criticism that comes with it". He also said that he remained "fully committed to Nvidia" and "supports the independent investigation".
"I am committed to protecting Nvidia and supporting America’s national security," Huang said.
Following Huang's admission, Nvidia announced that its board was launching an independent investigation into whether Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence operation.
Closing share price: US$186.64 on Friday (Nov 6), 2.8 per cent up from Nov 5.

Nov 9: Trump defends Huang Following the revelations, Nvidia's stock drop wiped about US$190 billion off its market value.
Meanwhile, Trump described Huang as an "honorable guy" who had "done an amazing job for our country". However, speaking to reporters, he said he had not discussed the affair allegations with Huang.
"I just know he's a fine person, but you never know what is going on," he added.
Chinese government officials again dismissed allegations of Chinese espionage during a routine press briefing on the same day. 
"The so-called allegations of Chinese espionage are entirely baseless and amount to nothing more than smears and attempts to discredit China," said Ministry of Foreign Affairs spokesperson Guo Jiakun.
Closing share price: US$178.67, down 4.3 per cent from Nov 6.
Nov 10: Shareholder sues Nvidia and Huang The Associated Press (AP) on Nov 10 reported that a shareholder had sued Nvidia and Huang , accusing them of deceiving investors in their responses about Huang’s affair.
The complaint accused Nvidia and Huang of failing to disclose the affair and issuing false statements about Nvidia’s relationship with Singapore-based Megaspeed, which posed a “material risk” to Nvidia’s reputation and business prospects.
It is common for shareholders to sue companies after unexpected share price declines.
Closing share price: US$168.89, down 5.5 per cent from Nov 9.

Related:

Alice Huang in touch with Chinese spy agency during affair with Nvidia CEO: Report

US lawmakers criticise Nvidia decision to reinstate Huang as CEO

Nov 11: Alleged second affair involving Huang In another blow to Huang’s reputation, the New York Times on Nov 11 reported the tech billionaire had an extramarital affair with Kimberly Powell , the company’s vice president of health care.
The report cited five people who worked at the company, and followed another report that Nvidia’s company board was preparing to oust Huang from his position.
While this affair remained unconfirmed, Nvidia shares fell nearly 4 per cent in extended trading.
Closing share price: US$173.73, up 2.9 per cent from Nov 10.
Nov 12: Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO Huang announced his resignation as CEO of Nvidia on Nov 12, with the company’s chief financial officer Colette Kress taking over as interim CEO.
Kress and longtime Nvidia engineer Ian Buck had emerged as the leading internal candidates among investors and analysts even before Huang's departure.
Closing share price: US$166.19, 4.3 per cent down from Nov 11.
Nov 13: US lawmakers summon Huang US lawmakers on Nov 13 summoned Huang to face their questions in December following his resignation. At this point, the scandal had wiped almost half a trillion dollars off Nvidia's market valuation, AFP reported.
"Recent reports raise serious concerns about our national security and the protection of sensitive US technology," Republican Senator Tim Scott wrote on X.
Scott added that he was requesting Huang and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick to testify in December before the Senate Banking Committee, which he chairs, last week.
Huang is also scheduled for a closed-door interview with three House of Representatives committees on Dec 1, on threat of subpoena.
Closing share price: US$162.85, 2 per cent down from Nov 12.

Nov 16: Huang discusses comeback with allies Citing people familiar with the matter, the Financial Times on Nov 16 reported that Huang was considering a comeback as Nvidia’s CEO.
One source told FT that they were putting together a "war room" of Silicon Valley executives to lobby for Huang’s return and also try to garner support from the White House.
The campaign to reinstate him as CEO saw support from tech industry leaders and many of Nvidia’s employees.
SpaceX and Tesla boss Elon Musk and Tim Sweeney, CEO of video game maker Epic Games, were among thousands of people who signed an online petition calling for Huang to return to the company.
Trump told reporters that he would welcome Huang’s return at Nvidia. "I would certainly not mind seeing that.
"I think he learned a big lesson."
Closing share price: US$156.14, 4.1 per cent down from Nov 13.
Nov 17: Nvidia chair says board will not rehire Huang Nvidia chairman Harvey Jones on Nov 17 said the board did not intend to reinstate Huang as CEO , despite the latter saying that he was ready to return.
Hours before Nvidia’s quarterly results were released on Nov 17, Huang said he "would be honoured" to come back as CEO if the board decided his return would be in the best interest of shareholders and employees.

Jensen Huang reacts as employees applaud his return to office after Nvidia reinstated him as the company's CEO, in Santa Clara, California, US on Nov 23, 2026, in this screengrab obtained from a social media video. (Photo: Zhengzhong Tu/via Reuters)

However, Jones quashed that possibility on a call with analysts after Nvidia's earnings were released, saying the board would take the search for a new CEO "very seriously" and would consider internal and external candidates.
Nvidia doubled its revenue in its third quarter to more than US$115 billion, the company reported on Nov 17, exceeding analysts' expectations. 
Closing share price: US$155.46, 0.4 per cent down from Nov 16.
Nov 20: Nvidia shares fall further, Trump calls for second chance Anthropic’s much-hyped arrival on Wall Street could not arrest Nvidia's slide. The record US$81 billion listing failed to dispel growing worries about the sector’s massive investments and sky-high evaluations.
Traders were also spooked by the US Commerce Department's move to close a loophole allowing Chinese companies to access Nvidia's powerful AI chips remotely, adding to worries that a new Democratic-led Congress will impose further restrictions on the sector.
Meanwhile, Trump again sang Huang's praises, saying that the former CEO should be "given a second chance".
"I would love to see him be back. You have one of the truly most brilliant minds in the world, and where is he going to go?" Trump told reporters.
"I think that I would love to see Jensen be given a second chance."

items.title: 独ＩＦＯ業況指数、11月は予想上回る上昇　今四半期の景気拡大裏付け
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Maria Martinez

[ベルリン ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Maria Martinez

[ベルリン ２４日 ロイター] - 独ＩＦＯ経済研究所が２４日発表した１１月の業況指数は９０．６と、１０月の改定値９０．１から上昇した。ロイターがまとめたアナリスト予想の９０．５を小幅に上回った。上昇は７カ月連続。好調な購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）に続き、第４・四半期の景気回復を示す材料となった。

ＩＦＯのクラウス・ウォールラーベ調査部長は「景気回復は勢いを増している」と述べ、状況の改善は第４・四半期も国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）が増加することを示唆しているとした。

キャピタル・エコノミクスの欧州担当チーフエコノミスト、アンドルー・ケニンガム氏は、政府の財政刺激策と輸出増加を背景に、年明けも成長が続くと予想した。

現況指数は１０月の８８．８から８９．４に上昇した。先行きの見通しを示す期待指数も９１．５から９１．９に上昇した。

ドイツ銀行リサーチのエコノミスト、マルク・シャッテンベルク氏は「直近のＰＭＩも予想を上回ったことから、第４・四半期の国内経済は年末にかけて力強い伸びを期待できる」と述べた。

ＩＦＯのクレメンス・フュースト所長は「独経済の回復は進んでいるが、広がりに欠ける」と述べた。

業種別では、製造業と建設業で指数が低下した一方、サービス業と商業では上昇した。

items.title: ケータリング世界最大手コンパス、主要上場先をＮＹに変更へ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２４日 ロイター] - 世界最大のケータリング企業であるコンパスは２４日、主要な上場先をロンドンからニューヨークに移す計画を確認した。英国株式市場にとって新たな打撃となる。

利益の７５％を占める北米に軸足を移す選択は自然な成り行きだったと説明。ドミニク・ブレークモア最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は声明で「この措置により、資本市場におけるプレゼンスを、当社の規模や事業展開地域とより適切に整合させ、事業の次の成長段階に向けた基盤をさらに強固なものにすることができる」と述べた。

同社は、２０２８年に実施される見込みのこの動きについて、株主と協議を行うとしている。英国との重複上場は維持するという。

コンパスの株価は３％上昇した。

コンパスによると、９月３０日に終了した事業年度の売上高はオーガニックベースで７．５％増加し、同社がまとめた市場予想の７．２％増を上回った。基礎的営業利益は１２％増の３７億５０００万ドルとなり、概ね予想通りだった。

同社は、約７％の売上高成長にけん引され、２７年度には営業利益が１桁台後半の伸びを示すと見込んでいる。

また、今後２年間で最大１５億ドルを株主に還元する計画を発表した。

items.title: インタビュー：日銀は来年2％まで利上げか、経済・株価絡み判断難しく＝安達元委員
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Takahiko Wada　Leika Kihara

［東京　２４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Takahiko Wada　Leika Kihara

［東京　２４日　ロイター］ - 元日銀審議委員の安達誠司氏は２４日、ロイターのインタビューで、日銀は来年、政策金利を２％まで引き上げる可能性があると述べた。基調的な物価上昇率の２％到達で政策運営の重心はインフレ抑制に移ると指摘。ただ、脆弱な経済や株価動向も絡み、利上げ判断は難しくなるとした。次回利上げについて、市場では１２月か来年１月と予想しているが、個人消費が弱い中で「無理に１２月に利上げする必要があるのか」と話した。

安達氏は、日銀が１０月の金融政策決定会合で基調物価が２％目標と「おおむね整合的な水準となった」と表明したことで、現在の政策金利１．２５％が中立金利だと指摘した。中立金利に到達したことで、金融政策の重心はインフレ抑制に移るとした。安達氏はこれまで中立金利を１．２５％程度とみてきた。

２０２７年度の消費者物価指数（生鮮食品を除く、コアＣＰＩ）については、政府の物価高対策や飲食料品の消費税率引き下げを加味しても「２％を少し上回る程度」と予想。輸入物価の上昇が物価を押し上げる構図が続き、追加利上げが必要になると話した。

一方で景気は弱く、特に個人消費が想定より悪いとみる。コロナ禍以降、個人消費は年率０．５％増で推移してきたものの、今年に入り「だんだん下振れている」とした。貯蓄率が上昇しており、物価高のほかに金利上昇が影響している可能性があると指摘。消費改善を狙って政府が経済対策を打ち出しても、節約志向で貯蓄に回るだけで逆効果になるおそれがあるという。

東短リサーチ／東短ＩＣＡＰによれば、市場が織り込む日銀の利上げ確率は１２月が８０％で来年１月が１６％（２４日午後時点）となっているが、安達氏は「無理に１２月に利上げする必要があるのか」とみる。株安がさらに進めば「消費はさらに悪くなる」という。

安達氏は、今後の利上げは物価・経済・株価動向などをにらみながら難しい判断になるとみている。物価に上昇圧力が掛かる中、脆弱な景気に配慮して利上げを見送り続ければビハインド・ザ・カーブに陥るリスクがあると警戒感を示す。一方で、政治サイドから利上げけん制が強まる可能性もあり、日銀は「年３回の利上げにチャレンジするイメージ」と語る。

今後の利上げで打撃を受けるのは家計となりそうで、政権がどこまで利上げを許容するかが焦点になるという。

来年７月にはタカ派に位置する高田創、田村直樹両審議委員が退任する。安達氏は後任が２人ともリフレ派になる可能性も「十二分にある」と述べた。

items.author: ロイター

items.summary:
Muayad Hameed　Tala Ramadan　Maha El Dahan

[バグダッド　２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Muayad Hameed　Tala Ramadan　Maha El Dahan

[バグダッド　２４日 ロイター] - イラクのザイディ首相は、クルド人治安部隊の支配地域にある油田を連邦政府のエネルギー当局が管理するよう命じた。重武装した親イラン民兵組織抑制に続く措置で、クルド自治区との緊張が一段と高まる可能性がある。

ザイディ氏は、イラクでイランと連携する最有力民兵組織「カタイブ・ヒズボラ」と、盗んだ石油から数億ドルの収益を得る密輸網を長年運営していた疑いのある政府高官らの取り締まりを進めている。

密輸取り締まりと北部油田の管理権掌握に向けた動きにより、巨額の資産を持つ実業家で現在４１歳のザイディ氏は、数十年にわたって連邦政府の統制に抵抗してきた二大勢力である親イラン民兵組織とクルド人指導部との直接対決に向かっている。いずれの措置も、２００３年にサダム・フセイン政権が妥当されて以降、民族・宗派間の内戦による混乱が続く中で勢力を大幅に拡大した組織の重大な利害に踏み込むもの。フセイン政権崩壊当時、ザイディ氏はまだ１０代だった。

カタイブ・ヒズボラは武装集団で政治的影響力も持ち、イラクで処罰を免れて活動しているとされる親イラン武装組織の一つ。密輸網に関する政府高官レベルの公式調査の結果を否定している。

クルド自治政府のマスルール・バルザニ首相は、石油と国境検問所の管理を一元化する連邦政府の決定について、不可解で「到底受け入れられない」と拒否。「相反するメッセージが出されている。われわれが会談した代表団は、憲法に基づいて懸案の解決を目指すという、これとは異なるメッセージを伝えていた」と述べた。

首相府が２４日に発表した命令は、東部ディヤラ、北部キルクーク、中部サラハディン、北部ニナワの各州にある油田が対象となる。北部石油会社（ＮＯＣ）での石油密輸を巡る捜査を受けた措置だ。

首相府は声明で、今回の指示について「国家主権は分割できず、イラクの富を守ることは国家の存続を懸けた戦いであり、国はあらゆる形の密輸を終わらせる」との原則に基づくと説明した。

ザイディ氏はさらにトルコ、イラン、シリアと国境を接するクルド自治区の全ての国境検問所を国境管理当局が引き継ぐよう命じた。クルド当局が数十年にわたって求めてきた自治に正面から挑む動きとなる。またクルド自治政府に対し、原油と石油製品の輸出は連邦政府の石油省を通じたものに限って承認するよう指示した。

国境検問所管理当局のトップを解任し、捜査がさらに進むまでＮＯＣの総責任者とその副責任者らを停職処分とした。

連邦政府とクルド当局の関係は長年、緊張が続いている。

イラクのクルド人勢力は１７年に独立を問う住民投票を実施し、イラク政府などの強い反発を招いた。連邦政府は軍事・経済面で報復措置を取り、戦略的に重要な産油都市キルクークなどの地域を掌握した。

クルド当局が連邦政府の承認を得ずに石油を販売したことを巡る過去の対立では、トルコ向けのパイプライン輸送が２年以上停止。双方は２５年９月に輸送再開で合意した。

政治経験の浅いザイディ氏は、イラクへの大規模投資の誘致を目指している。ただ、アナリストは、まずフセイン政権崩壊以降欠けている政治・経済の安定を確立する必要があると指摘する。

親フセイン勢力や国際武装組織アルカイダによる反乱、宗派間の内戦、経済の荒廃といった混乱に加え、民兵組織やそれを支える有力なイスラム教シーア派政治家との強い結び付きが、イランによるイラクでの広範な影響力拡大を可能にしてきた。イラクは米国とイランの双方と協力関係にある。

items.title: イスラエルがガザ空爆、ハマス治安部門幹部を殺害　ネタニヤフ首相称賛
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Nidal al-Mughrabi

[カイロ ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Nidal al-Mughrabi

[カイロ ２４日 ロイター] - イスラエルは２４日、パレスチナ自治区ガザを空爆し、イスラム組織ハマスの治安部門幹部を殺害した。

パレスチナの医療関係者や警察によると、ガザのハマス内部治安機関トップ、ナイーム・アブナヘル氏が死亡した。ガザでは２４日、空爆により同氏や警察官２人を含め少なくとも７人のパレスチナ人が死亡した。

ハマスが運営するガザの内務省は、アブナヘル氏がイスラエルへの協力者や同国の支援を受けてガザでハマス打倒を目指す武装民兵への対処を担っていたため、イスラエルに「暗殺された」と述べた。

イスラエルのネタニヤフ首相はアブナヘル氏を名指しし、殺害したイスラエル軍を称賛。首相府が発表した声明でネタニヤフ氏は「いかなるテロリストも、どこまでも及ぶイスラエル国家の力から逃れることはできない」と表明した。

医療関係者によると、南部ハンユニスの警察拠点に対する空爆では３人が死亡。ハマスが運営する内務省は、そのうち２人が警察官だったと発表した。この攻撃では他に５人が負傷。また、同日には、さらに北にあるネツァリム回廊付近で別の空爆があり、他に３人が死亡した。

この空爆について、イスラエル軍はロイターに対し、過激派を攻撃したと説明した。

ハマスが再編と再武装を図っていると非難するイスラエルはここ数カ月、ガザへの攻撃を強化。ハマスはイスラエルの主張を否定し、停戦合意を順守していると述べるとともに、イスラエルが合意を頓挫させようとしていると非難している。

イスラエルによるガザ攻撃では２３年以降、７万４０００人を超えるパレスチナ人が死亡している。

BENGALURU, Nov 24 : Will Thomas has played Fantasy Premier League (FPL) for over 15 years. Last season, the AI he built finished above him for the first time.
"That was a bit of a surreal moment. I thought, 'oh my God, I'm being beaten by my own creation'," he told Reuters.
According to industry research, Thomas is one of around 245 million people who play fantasy sports, where players take the role of manager or coach and build a virtual team made up of athletes whose real-life performances earn them points.
Englishman Thomas is also CEO and founder of Scoreline.ai, which delivers subscriber-based content including data, insight and analytics designed to help players manage their fantasy sports teams.

Among its products is Fantasy Football Hub, which has around 60,000 paying subscribers and focuses on FPL - the official fantasy competition of the English Premier League.
FPL offers match tickets and replica kits as prizes and had over 13 million registered teams in the 2025-26 season.
Scoreline.ai's purpose-built model finished in the top 0.5 per cent of those teams, ranking 67,829th in the world.
"There are still human managers beating it, but it's getting harder to do," said Thomas, who has a PhD in team leadership at the University of Sussex.
HOW DOES AI MATCH UP TO THE BEST HUMAN PLAYERS?
A Reuters analysis of nine FPL teams, seven of which were run on the directions of AI chatbots, showed that the chatbot teams scored an average of 499 points in the first eight gameweeks of the 2026-27 FPL season.
The chatbot teams which Reuters analysed were operated by Scout Digital, a sports marketing firm that gives each separate chatbot the same instructions every week and, in most cases, has a staff member log in to carry out its decisions.
Their performances were in line with the average human benchmark of 502, but about 75 points below the average of the top 1,000 human players, showing that AI has improved sharply but has not yet caught up to the best.
Reuters' analysis found chatbots still fall short of the best players on judgment calls such as captaincy picks, which earn double points, even as they match the top managers' discipline on transfers.
Scout Digital said newer versions of each AI model are used as they are released.
As a control, Scout Digital also has a team titled Scout Statto, which is managed by the firm's co-founder Simon Gold and run without the use of AI tools.
"So far, we're two seasons in and the improvement we've seen is huge," said managing director Mike Lewis.
"In 2025-26, Scout Statto comfortably won. This season is looking neck and neck."
WHERE COULD HUMANS HAVE THE EDGE?
Daniel Groos, head of AI at Groos Analytics, who built the open-source forecasting model OpenFPL, said the hardest question remains whether a player will even be in action on any particular gameweek and not dropped, rested or injured.
Jonas Sand Labakk, the 2023-24 FPL champion, said that is where human discretion is essential.
"Where you need human input is the expected minutes for players, because rotation, injuries and managerial choices are where I think the models miss the most," he told Reuters.
Groos added that overall, machines have an advantage because humans tend to be influenced by a spectacular performance, media narratives or a favourite player.
The chatbot teams make about as few transfers as the best human managers, and the gap in transfer volume is small.
The chatbot teams' captain picks trail those of the top 1,000 human players. They also leave more points on the bench than the typical manager.
The top 1,000 do not play against the grain. They own more popular players than the average manager, not fewer, which undercuts the idea that beating the field takes contrarian bets.
Thomas also argues that the machines are weakest at the start of a season, when new managers and players give the models little data, and that fans of specific teams may have a slight insight advantage.
However, the early numbers do not clearly show that.
The chatbot teams Reuters analysed were level with the official average in gameweek 1 of this season, pulled ahead in gameweek 2, and had dipped just below it by gameweek 8.
USING AI AS A CO-PILOT, NOT AN AUTOPILOT
While some predict a future where fantasy sports become a battleground purely for competing versions of AI, Groos does not expect the human element to disappear completely.
"The winning formula may turn out to be neither human intuition nor AI-based insights, but a combination of both," he said.
Labakk echoed that, adding: "I think the best possible way is an engaged manager with the models rather than an AI with the models."
That is how Marcus Adebayo, 34, a software project manager from South London, uses Gemini. He lets it do the "structural heavy lifting" but picks the team himself.
"Treating it as a co-pilot works brilliantly, provided you're honest enough to admit that when the plane hits turbulence, it's usually because you grabbed the controls," he said.
Beginning this season, FPL features its own conversational AI assistant titled FPL Companion.

Source: Reuters

TOKYO: Japan will pay its full 2027 contribution to the International Criminal Court by year-end, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said on Tuesday (Nov 24), after the court sought early payment from its largest contributor amid US sanctions.
Takaichi informed ICC President Tomoko Akane of the decision during a meeting at her office on Tuesday, the prime minister said in a post on social media website X.
Japan's backing comes as its key security partner, the United States, pushes to dismantle the body through sanctions and by encouraging members to leave.
Japan supplies around 15 per cent of the money needed to cover the court's budget, making it the largest financial contributor, followed by Germany, France, Britain, Italy, South Korea and Canada.
The early payment will allow the ICC to have access to funding before US sanctions take full effect in April 2027.
Japan's move could encourage other major contributors to make early payments, creating a meaningful cash buffer before sanctions bite, analysts say.

Source: Reuters/ec

items.title: 台湾、「英雄」フアン氏復帰に沸く　主要株価指数も9％高で反応
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Wen-Yee Lee　Yi-Chin Lee

[台北 ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Wen-Yee Lee　Yi-Chin Lee

[台北 ２４日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の出身地である台湾では、「英雄」のＣＥＯ復帰を歓迎する声が相次いだ。

台湾は世界のＡＩ（人工知能）サプライチェーン（供給網）で極めて重要な拠点となっており、フアン氏は地元の大スター。彼の訪台には常に大勢のファンや記者が集まり、地元メディアはこの熱狂を「ジェンサニティ」と呼んでいる。

フアン氏の不倫が明るみに出たことや、外国の諜報活動による標的となっていたのではないかという疑惑が浮上したことを受けての辞任は、台湾に衝撃をもたらしたが、支持者たちは復帰の可能性を決してあきらめなかった。

台北で金融業界に勤めるビーナス・チャンさん（５１）は「彼が台湾にもたらした貢献は計り知れない。だからこそ、彼の復帰を心からうれしく思う」と語った。

３１歳のエンジニア、ゲイリー・ウーさんは、夜間にフアン氏復帰のニュースを見た後、真っ先に台湾の株式市場が上昇するだろうと考えた。「案の定、午前には株価が１日の上限値まで上昇しているのが確認できた」と話した。

台湾の主要株価指数は２４日の取引を９％高で終え、８カ月ぶりの安値から反発した。

11/24 17:30 配信

写真は「台湾、ハートマーク、ジェンセン」と書かれた「台北１０１」のディスプレイ。11月16日、台北で撮影。REUTERS/Ann Wang（ロイター） Wen-Yee Lee　Yi-Chin Lee

[台北 ２４日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の出身地である台湾では、「英雄」のＣＥＯ復帰を歓迎する声が相次いだ。

台湾は世界のＡＩ（人工知能）サプライチェーン（供給網）で極めて重要な拠点となっており、フアン氏は地元の大スター。彼の訪台には常に大勢のファンや記者が集まり、地元メディアはこの熱狂を「ジェンサニティ」と呼んでいる。

フアン氏の不倫が明るみに出たことや、外国の諜報活動による標的となっていたのではないかという疑惑が浮上したことを受けての辞任は、台湾に衝撃をもたらしたが、支持者たちは復帰の可能性を決してあきらめなかった。

台北で金融業界に勤めるビーナス・チャンさん（５１）は「彼が台湾にもたらした貢献は計り知れない。だからこそ、彼の復帰を心からうれしく思う」と語った。

３１歳のエンジニア、ゲイリー・ウーさんは、夜間にフアン氏復帰のニュースを見た後、真っ先に台湾の株式市場が上昇するだろうと考えた。「案の定、午前には株価が１日の上限値まで上昇しているのが確認できた」と話した。

台湾の主要株価指数は２４日の取引を９％高で終え、８カ月ぶりの安値から反発した。

台湾最大の金融持株会社である国泰金融の李長庚総経理は「もちろん、台湾はジェンスン・フアン氏の復帰を心から歓迎している。当然ながら、台湾のサプライチェーン企業が引き続き大きな利益を上げられるよう、ＡＩ開発が継続されることを期待している」と述べた。

FAST

TOKYO, Nov 24 : The Japanese government downgraded its view on consumer spending in November for the first time in more than 2-1/2 years as rising prices weighed on consumer sentiment.
Here are the main points from the report:
• On private consumption, the government cut its view on consumer spending for the first time since February 2024, saying it "appears to be pausing for picking up." In October, it said spending was "showing movements of picking up."
• On exports, the government upgraded its view for the first time since June, to "showing movements of picking up," as shipments to the US and EU picked up. The government previously said there were signs the recovery had stalled.

• On industrial production, authorities raised their assessment for the first time since September, saying it was "picking up as a whole," led by production machinery including semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
• On business investment, capital spending is "picking up," unchanged from October.
• Imports remained flat.
• Overall, the government maintained its view that the economy is "recovering moderately as a whole," while continuing to caution about the impact of developments in the Middle East.
• On the outlook, better employment and income conditions are expected to support a moderate recovery, the government said. It warned about the impact of the US-Israeli war on Iran and volatility in the financial markets.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Tetsushi Kajimoto

［東京　２４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Tetsushi Kajimoto

［東京　２４日　ロイター］ - 政府は１１月の月例経済報告で、景気の基調判断を示す表現を前月までの「緩やかに回復している」から「総じて緩やかに回復している」に変更した。個別項目では物価高を背景に個人消費を下方修正する一方、輸出と生産を引き上げた。先行きについては前月の表現を踏襲した。

基調判断の表現は「総じてみれば緩やかに回復しているが、中東情勢の影響を注視する必要がある」とした。前月の表現に「総じてみれば」を加えたほかは変更はなかった。表現変更の背景には、堅調な企業部門と物価高や天候不順で足踏み状態の家計部門の温度差がある。

個別項目では、個人消費を３３カ月ぶりに下方修正した。物価高だけでなく、景気要因とは言えない自然災害や天候不順も影響したとしている。ビッグデータで１０月以降の動向を分析すると、持ち直しの傾向がみられるとも指摘した。

一方、輸出を５カ月ぶりに引き上げた。アジア向けは持ち直しの動きに足踏みがみられるものの、米国と欧州連合（ＥＵ）向けに持ち直しの動きがみられるとした。また、人工知能（ＡＩ）を支えるインフラ需要が強く、生産も２カ月ぶりに上方修正した。

※〔表〕月例経済報告の景気判断の推移は[L3N4710IA]をご覧ください。

items.title: Binance Hack: US Moves to Recover $1.1 Billion, but Who Gets the Money?
items.summary: Key takeawaysNearly four weeks after the Binance hack, US authorities have filed a civil forfeiture complaint seeking more than $1.1 billion in USDC linked to the October theft. The money is already ...
items.body:
News
/ NewsBTC
/ Binance Hack: US Moves to Recover $1.1 Billion, but Who Gets the Money?

Binance Hack: US Moves to Recover $1.1 Billion, but Who Gets the Money? 5 min read

USDCUSD BNBUSD
Key takeaways
US authorities filed a civil forfeiture complaint on November 23 seeking more than $1.1 billion in USDC linked to the October 29 Binance hack, across 36 addresses on 18 blockchains.
Circle froze the funds but says it cannot technically move them, so it proposes issuing replacement USDC to the US after a forfeiture order.
Frozen is not recovered: the filings advance the legal-control stage, while final distribution and ownership remain undecided.
A separate Abu Dhabi court order adds a second jurisdiction, and Circle’s reserve and supply reporting for the replacement tokens will deserve scrutiny.
Nearly four weeks after the Binance hack, US authorities have filed a civil forfeiture complaint seeking more than $1.1 billion in USDC linked to the October theft. The money is already subject to restrictions, but the latest court filings reveal a complication: freezing stolen cryptocurrency is considerably easier than returning it.
The complaint, filed on November 23, in the US District Court for the District of Columbia, targets USDC associated with 36 cryptocurrency addresses across 18 blockchains.

Federal investigators attribute the October 29 attack to North Korean hacking groups, including the Lazarus Group. The complaint puts the value of the original theft at approximately $6 billion.
For Binance, the latest legal action represents another opportunity to recover a portion of its losses. For the wider cryptocurrency industry, however, the case raises questions about the authority stablecoin issuers exercise over digital assets and what happens when governments become involved.
Binance Hack Recovery Enters a New Legal Phase
The assets targeted by US authorities are not an entirely new discovery.
Earlier this month, NewsBTC reported that Circle had frozen approximately $1.1 billion in USDC linked to the Binance hack, following cooperation with law enforcement.
What has changed is the government’s attempt to establish a legal basis for taking possession of those assets.
According to the court documents, US authorities obtained a temporary restraining order on November 12. Prosecutors subsequently requested that the restrictions remain in place throughout the civil forfeiture proceedings.
Both Binance and Circle consented to the initial restraining order and the requested extension, according to the government’s November 23 application.
The agreement between the companies and federal authorities reduces one immediate obstacle to preserving the funds. It does not, however, resolve the question of their ultimate ownership or distribution.
Civil forfeiture proceedings are directed against property believed to be connected to criminal activity. Interested parties can assert legitimate claims to that property through the legal process.
In this case, prosecutors are seeking forfeiture of the assets to the United States. That is not the same thing as a court ordering their immediate return to Binance.
Circle Cannot Simply Send the Frozen USDC Back
Perhaps the most interesting disclosure in the complaint concerns Circle itself.
The stablecoin issuer can restrict transfers involving USDC held at particular blockchain addresses. However, that authority does not necessarily give Circle direct control over the wallets holding those tokens.
The complaint states that Circle:
“ does not have the technical ability to transfer the Defendant Property from the blocklisted Subject Addresses to the United States
US forfeiture complaint · November 23 filing
Instead, Circle has agreed to issue an equivalent amount of replacement USDC and transfer those tokens to US authorities upon receiving a forfeiture order from the court.
The proposed arrangement exposes an unusual feature of centralized stablecoins. An issuer can prevent tokens from circulating without possessing the private keys needed to move them.
It also raises an accounting question that deserves attention. If replacement tokens are issued, what ultimately happens to the original frozen USDC, and how will Circle ensure that the treatment of those balances is reflected accurately in its outstanding supply and reserve reporting?
The issuance of replacement tokens would not, by itself, prove that USDC had become undercollateralized. Nevertheless, transparency around the implementation would be important for a stablecoin whose credibility depends on confidence in its backing.
The immediate concern is not whether Circle can create new tokens. It is whether the entire recovery process can be independently accounted for.
The $1.1 Billion Is Not Back With Binance Yet
The temptation to describe the Justice Department’s announcement as a billion-dollar recovery is understandable. It is also premature.
There are three separate stages involved: restricting access to the stolen assets, obtaining legal authority over them and determining how they will ultimately be distributed.
The November 23 filings advance the second stage. They do not establish that the third has been completed.
The $1.1 billion Binance recovery process. Source: US District Court for the District of Columbia filings, November 23, 2026.
There is also a cross-border complication.
On November 18, Reuters reported that an Abu Dhabi court had directed several cryptocurrency companies, including Circle, to preserve digital assets associated with the Binance theft.
The involvement of authorities in both the United States and the United Arab Emirates illustrates how a single cryptocurrency theft can generate legal proceedings across multiple jurisdictions.
Blockchain transactions may cross national borders without much difficulty. Establishing ownership rights over the assets involved is a considerably less straightforward exercise.
That does not mean the US and UAE proceedings are necessarily in conflict. But the ultimate disposition of the funds will require more than an announcement from either government.
For investors assessing Binance’s financial position, the distinction between frozen assets and recovered capital is particularly important. Restricted cryptocurrency should not automatically be treated as money already returned to the exchange.
The Binance Hack Tests the Case for Centralized Stablecoins
For years, the ability of stablecoin issuers to freeze tokens has been criticized by advocates of decentralized finance.
The Binance case demonstrates the other side of that argument.
Without Circle’s ability to restrict transactions, preserving such a large amount of cryptocurrency for potential recovery would have been more difficult.
In this particular case, centralized control has provided a mechanism that may help prevent suspected criminals from benefiting from stolen assets.
The uncomfortable question is whether the cryptocurrency industry can benefit from that authority while also demanding meaningful safeguards against its misuse.
The answer depends partly on transparency. Token holders should be able to understand why assets were frozen, under what legal authority restrictions remain in place and how disputes over ownership are resolved.
The same standard should apply to the exchange, the stablecoin issuer and the government.
The next significant development in the Binance case will be the court’s treatment of the forfeiture claim and any competing claims to the assets. Circle’s proposed issuance of replacement USDC will also deserve scrutiny if it proceeds.
Until then, the $1.1 billion should be understood as assets subject to an ongoing recovery effort, not a completed repayment.
For a cryptocurrency industry that frequently celebrates the speed of moving money, the Binance hack is a reminder that getting it back can be an entirely different business.

BOJ to keep hiking rates but soft spending muddies path, ex-central bank policymaker says

A Japanese flag flutters atop the Bank of Japan headquarters in Tokyo, Japan,September 18, 2026. REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

TOKYO, Nov 24 : The Bank of Japan will likely raise interest rates several more times to fight inflation, but its rate-hike plans may face political headwinds next year due to weak consumption, former central bank policymaker Seiji Adachi said on Tuesday.
While government fuel subsidies have moderated price pressure on households, inflation is likely to stay above the BOJ's 2 per cent target next year as firms pass on rising raw material costs, Adachi said in an interview with Reuters.
"Concern over rising inflation is strong, so the BOJ is not done with rate hikes yet," he said, projecting the central bank will raise its policy rate to 1.5 per cent from the current 1.25 per cent either in December or January.
The BOJ could then raise rates further to 1.75 per cent or 2.0 per cent next year to forestall the risk of an inflation overshoot, Adachi said.

But he warned that soft consumption may complicate the BOJ's rate-hike plans, with recent data showing signs of weakness in household spending.
"Consumption has been weakening this year and moving below recent years' trend," with rising living costs and higher interest rates prodding households to save rather than spend, Adachi said.
Signs of weak consumption may spur dovish premier Sanae Takaichi's administration and her reflationist aides to push back against further rate hikes, he said.
"If consumption stays weak, it could prove hard for the BOJ to justify steady rate hikes. Falling stock prices won't help either," said Adachi, who retains contact with incumbent policymakers and some of Takaichi's economic advisers.
"The pain from higher rates may hit households first through higher mortgage rates, which the administration may not feel happy about," Adachi said. "How far the administration is willing to tolerate could be key" to the pace and timing of any BOJ rate hikes next year, he added.
During his five-year stint at the BOJ board until 2025, Adachi took part in the central bank's exit from a massive decade-long stimulus in March 2024 and subsequent rate hikes.
With stubbornly high energy costs and rising import prices from a weak yen adding to inflationary pressures, the BOJ raised its policy rate to 1.25 per cent in September after delivering a hike in June — a shorter interval than the roughly twice-a-year hikes seen in 2024 and 2025.
BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda has signalled the bank's readiness to keep raising rates to prevent inflation from deviating above its 2 per cent target.
A majority of analysts polled by Reuters expect the BOJ to raise rates in December and follow up with another hike by end-March. Many see the terminal rate at around 1.75 per cent or 2.0 per cent.
Wary of triggering a fresh selloff in the yen and government bonds, Takaichi's administration has held off on publicly criticising the BOJ's recent rate hikes and hawkish signalling.
But two dovish BOJ board members dissented to the September rate hike on concern over weak growth and consumption.
Japan's economy unexpectedly shrank in the July-September quarter as consumption slumped, though Ueda last week played down the weakness as due to temporary factors such as bad weather.

Source: Reuters

items.title: 中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝中国小幅高、エヌビディアＣＥＯ復帰効果は一時的　香港は昨年5月以来の安値
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［上海　２４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［上海　２４日　ロイター］ - 中国株式市場は小幅高で終了した。エヌビディアの最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）にジェンスン・フアン氏が復帰したことが世界的に株価を押し上げる中、中国株への効果は限定的だった。

中国のＣＳＩ３００指数は０．１％高、上海総合指数は０．３％高で引けたものの、ともに約１６カ月ぶりの安値付近にとどまった。

投資家の間では、一連の騒動でフアン氏の米中間の橋渡し役としての役割が弱まったとの見方が出ている。つまるところ、今の中国株低迷を下支えできるのは「国家隊」と呼ばれる中国政府系投資家との声も聞かれた。

人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の一角が買われたものの、上げ幅を維持できなかった。５Ｇ通信指数は一時７％上昇した後、上げ幅を２％に縮小。エヌビディアに光送受信機を供給する中際旭創（ジョンジー・イノライト）は一時１２％急騰したものの、その後上げ幅のほぼ全てを失った。

シェンチー・キャピタル（香港）のゼン・ウェンカイ最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）氏は「（フアン氏復帰は）朝の取引で分かる通り、間違いなく市場を活気づける材料だ」とした上で、「ただ、Ａ株と香港株は世界市場とは独立した独自の動きをする。今は『国家隊』がどれほど強力に市場支援に乗り出すかにかかっている」と指摘した。

前日、上海総合指数は２０２５年７月以来の安値に下落した後、下げ幅を縮小した。トレーダーによると、政府系投資家が相場を下支えするため、主要指数に連動する上場投資信託（ＥＴＦ）の一部を買い入れていた。

＜中国市場の救済が目的ではない＞

北京モノリス・ファンド・マネジメントのファンドマネジャー、ゼン・ワンピン氏は、フアン氏の復帰はエヌビディアの供給網に加わる中国企業に恩恵をもたらすものの、米国が中国向け半導体規制を緩和することはないと指摘。「フアン氏復帰の一因は米株式相場の急落だった。中国株式市場を救済するためではない」と述べた。

上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け市場「科創板」５０指数は１．６％高にとどまり、メモリー半導体大手ＣＸＭＴも１％の上昇にとどまった。

香港のハンセン指数は０．７％下落し、２５年５月以来の安値を付けた。ハンセン人工知能指数は６％高で寄り付いたが、その後は上げ幅を全て失い、０．７％安で取引された。

サクソのシンガポール在勤チーフ投資ストラテジスト、チャル・チャナナ氏は、フアン氏が中国市場へのアクセス維持を訴えていたことを踏まえ、同氏の復帰によって、米中の技術関係に対する、より現実的な対応への期待が再燃するとみる。しかし「復帰を巡る政治的な論争によって、エヌビディアの中国事業への監視はむしろ強まる可能性がある。誰がエヌビディアを率いても、輸出規制は構造的な制約であり続ける」と指摘した。

items.title: インドネシア政府系ファンド、利益は今年目標未達　27年は6倍増見込む
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Stefanno Sulaiman　Gayatri Suroyo

[ジャカルタ ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Stefanno Sulaiman　Gayatri Suroyo

[ジャカルタ ２４日 ロイター] - インドネシア政府系ファンドの投資部門は、国内株式への投資による損失により、今年の純利益目標を達成できない見通しだ。幹部らが２４日に明らかにした。ただ、２０２７年には利益が６倍に増加すると見込んでいる。

幹部らによると、ダナンタラ・インベストメント・マネジメント（ＤＩＭ）の２６年の純利益は８０００億ルピア（４３９８万ドル）になると見込まれており、従来の目標である３兆４０００億ルピアを大幅に下回る見通し。

２７年の目標は５兆─６兆ルピアとされている。

ＤＩＭの親会社、ダナンタラ・インドネシアのロサン・ルスラニ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は議会公聴会で「主な原因は足元の資本市場への圧力で、投資が大幅に落ち込んだ」と述べた。

ダナンタラ・インドネシアがプラボウォ大統領によって２５年２月に設立されて以来、初めて業績が公表された。ダナンタラは、インドネシアの国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）成長率を近年の５％から２９年までに８％に引き上げる役割を担っている。

ダナンタラは、財政黒字や資源収入の余剰を原資とするのではなく、国有企業の統合によって設立された点で、大半の政府系ファンドとは異なる。

＜株式市場の低迷＞

ＤＩＭの平均自己資本利益率（ＲＯＡＥ）は２６年に０．８％、２７年には３．８─４．１％になる見通し。ＤＩＭのパンドゥ・シャフリルＣＥＯは、３０年までに８％に引き上げたいと述べた。

ＤＩＭは公開市場で運用するポートフォリオの約９％をインドネシア株に、４０％超を先進国株に投資していた。幹部によると分散投資が最終損益への打撃を和らげたという。

財政健全性や中央銀行の独立性に対する懸念から、今年は投資家のセンチメントが弱まっている。さらに、指数プロバイダーのＭＳＣＩが、透明性の問題からインドネシア株式市場の分類を現在の「新興国市場」から「スタンドアローン市場」に引き下げる可能性があると警告したことで、資本が大規模に流出した。

インドネシアの主要株価指数は今年に入ってからこれまでに４０％近く下落し、世界で最もパフォーマンスの悪い指数となっている。ルピアも今年に入って８％以上下落しており、ここ数週間で過去最安値を何度も更新している。

ＤＩＭの公開市場でのポートフォリオの約３１％は債券などの確定利付き資産だった。人工知能（ＡＩ）とその関連分野への投資比率は推計１９％。

２７年の利益をけん引する要因について具体的な見通しは示されなかったが、シャフリル氏は、ルピア相場と金利の変動に左右されやすいと指摘した。

＜運用資産、最大７０％増へ＞

ＤＩＭは既存の国有企業からの配当を資本の原資としている。債券市場や銀行融資からも資金を調達している。

２６年の運用資産総額は２４８兆ルピアとなる見通しで、その４分の３超が公開市場での投資に振り向けられている。

２７年には５０兆ルピアの資本注入と約１２２兆ルピアの追加資金調達を見込み、資産総額は３９０兆─４２１兆ルピアに達すると予測している。レンジ上限の場合、前年比７０％増となる。

２７年には非公開市場での投資比率が４５％に上昇する見通し。非公開市場での投資案件には、インドネシアのＡＩインフラ事業や、聖地メッカでの不動産が含まれる。

＜投資部門＞

ダナンタラのもう一つの投資部門であるダナンタラ・デベロップメント・マネジメント・ファンドは、収益性は低いが重要な事業への投資を統括している。２７年には４２兆ルピアの資本注入を受けると明らかにした。

この資金を基に共同投資家や開発金融機関、銀行からも資金を集め、２７年の投資総額は３５４兆ルピアに達する可能性があるという。

同部門が進める事業には、国産電気自動車（ＥＶ）や電動バイクの製造、石炭ガス化が含まれるという。同部門の資本も、既存の国有企業からの配当を原資としている。

インドネシア政府系ファンド、利益は今年目標未達　27年は6倍増見込む
11/24 16:48 配信

ジャカルタにあるダナンタラ・インドネシア本社前で６月撮影。 REUTERS/Ajeng Dinar Ulfiana（ロイター） Stefanno Sulaiman　Gayatri Suroyo

[ジャカルタ ２４日 ロイター] - インドネシア政府系ファンドの投資部門は、国内株式への投資による損失により、今年の純利益目標を達成できない見通しだ。幹部らが２４日に明らかにした。ただ、２０２７年には利益が６倍に増加すると見込んでいる。

幹部らによると、ダナンタラ・インベストメント・マネジメント（ＤＩＭ）の２６年の純利益は８０００億ルピア（４３９８万ドル）になると見込まれており、従来の目標である３兆４０００億ルピアを大幅に下回る見通し。

２７年の目標は５兆─６兆ルピアとされている。

ＤＩＭの親会社、ダナンタラ・インドネシアのロサン・ルスラニ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は議会公聴会で「主な原因は足元の資本市場への圧力で、投資が大幅に落ち込んだ」と述べた。

ダナンタラは、財政黒字や資源収入の余剰を原資とするのではなく、国有企業の統合によって設立された点で、大半の政府系ファンドとは異なる。

items.body:
［東京　２４日　ロイター］ - ＬＩＸＩＬは２４日、一部の建材・設備機器の希望小売価格を値上げすると発表した。原材料価格の高騰や製造コスト・物流費の上昇が続く中で、企業努力のみで対応することは困難な状況と判断した。

items.title: ストの脅威に直面するフォルクスワーゲン、労組との賃金交渉開始
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Rachel More

[エムデン（ドイツ） ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Rachel More

[エムデン（ドイツ） ２４日 ロイター] - ドイツの自動車大手フォルクスワーゲンは２４日、人員削減を拡大しコスト削減を推進する計画を巡りストライキの脅威が高まる中、強力な労働組合代表団との賃金交渉を開始する。

国内工場が再編の焦点となっており、従業員には、国内での生産コストが高くなりすぎたとの説明がなされている。

第１回交渉は、工場の一つがあるドイツ北部のエムデンで行われる。

フォルクスワーゲンは、２０２７年と２８年に国内従業員の賃金を凍結し、各種福利厚生を削減したい意向を示している。また、労働組合が苦闘の末に勝ち取った週３５時間労働制についても譲歩を求め、必要に応じて同じ賃金でより長く働くよう従業員に求めている。

ドイツ国内では、自動車産業の競争力を巡って激しい議論が繰り広げられており、業界全体でのストライキはすでに始まっている。

フォルクスワーゲンでは、１月１日からストライキが始まる可能性がある。労組は今回の新たな再編の動きについて、２４年終盤に締結された画期的な再編合意に違反するものと主張している。

items.title: 仏製薬サノフィ、米インスメッド410億ドルで買収へ　呼吸器分野強化
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２４日　ロイター］ - 仏製薬大手サノフィは２４日、米同業インスメッドを４１０億ドルで買収すると発表した。５月に就任し、戦略の見直しに取り組むベレン・ガリホ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の下で最大規模の買収案件となる。

サノフィによると、インスメッド株１株につき１７５ドルを支払う。直近終値に対して約１７．５％、ブルームバーグ・ニュースが両社の買収交渉の可能性を報じた前日（１１月１８日）の終値と比べると４６％のプレミアムを上乗せした水準。

買収資金は、借り入れと手元資金で賄う。すでに融資の確約を取り付けたとしている。

フランソワ・ロジェ最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は記者団に対し、「今回の案件は現金による取引として欧州で過去４番目、フランスでは過去最大の規模だ」と語った。

サノフィでは、主力製品のぜんそく治療薬「デュピクセント」が３０年代初めに特許切れを迎える。新薬候補のパイプラインを立て直し、デュピクセントの特許切れ後も成長できる道筋を目指す中で同社初の女性ＣＥＯとなったガリホ氏は、戦略の見直しに着手し、１０月１日には長年提携関係にある米リジェネロン・ファーマシューティカルズと４種類の新薬開発で協力する８０億ドル規模の契約を締結した。

ガリホ氏は、インスメッド買収は免疫学分野におけるサノフィの能力を強め、リジェネロンとの提携を補う効果もあると述べた。

サノフィによると、買収は２０２７年上半期に完了する見通しで、２０２８年末までに１株当たり利益を押し上げる効果が出る見込み。ロジェ氏は、年５億ドルを超えるコスト削減効果があるとの試算を示した。

インスメッドは、すでに承認を得た呼吸器疾患治療薬を２種類販売している。「ブリンスプリ」は非嚢胞性線維症性気管支拡張症向けで、「アリケイス」は難治性のマイコバクテリウム・アビウム・コンプレックス（ＭＡＣ）肺症向けの薬だ。

ガリホ氏は、これらの製品群のピーク時売上高について３０年代末までに合計で１００億ドルを超える見込みだと述べた。

「当社には世界的な販売網と呼吸器疾患での経験、患者を支援する能力がある。販売中の医薬品をより多くの患者に届け、その潜在力を最大限に引き出すことができる」と語った。

ロジェ氏は、既存のパイプラインを補うためのボルトオン買収を行える余地は残す方針だと説明した。特に、免疫学、希少疾患、ワクチンの各分野で第１相・第２相臨床試験の段階にある新薬候補が対象になるという。

サノフィによると、インスメッド株１株につき１７５ドルを支払う。直近終値に対して約１７．５％、ブルームバーグ・ニュースが両社の買収交渉の可能性を報じた前日（１１月１８日）の終値と比べると４６％のプレミアムを上乗せした水準。

買収資金は、借り入れと手元資金で賄う。すでに融資の確約を取り付けたとしている。

フランソワ・ロジェ最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は記者団に対し、「今回の案件は現金による取引として欧州で過去４番目、フランスでは過去最大の規模だ」と語った。

サノフィでは、主力製品のぜんそく治療薬「デュピクセント」が３０年代初めに特許切れを迎える。新薬候補のパイプラインを立て直し、デュピクセントの特許切れ後も成長できる道筋を目指す中で同社初の女性ＣＥＯとなったガリホ氏は、戦略の見直しに着手し、１０月１日には長年提携関係にある米リジェネロン・ファーマシューティカルズと４種類の新薬開発で協力する８０億ドル規模の契約を締結した。

ガリホ氏は、インスメッド買収は免疫学分野におけるサノフィの能力を強め、リジェネロンとの提携を補う効果もあると述べた。

サノフィによると、買収は２０２７年上半期に完了する見通しで、２０２８年末までに１株当たり利益を押し上げる効果が出る見込み。ロジェ氏は、年５億ドルを超えるコスト削減効果があるとの試算を示した。

インスメッドは、すでに承認を得た呼吸器疾患治療薬を２種類販売している。「ブリンスプリ」は非嚢胞性線維症性気管支拡張症向けで、「アリケイス」は難治性のマイコバクテリウム・アビウム・コンプレックス（ＭＡＣ）肺症向けの薬だ。

ガリホ氏は、これらの製品群のピーク時売上高について３０年代末までに合計で１００億ドルを超える見込みだと述べた。

「当社には世界的な販売網と呼吸器疾患での経験、患者を支援する能力がある。販売中の医薬品をより多くの患者に届け、その潜在力を最大限に引き出すことができる」と語った。

ロジェ氏は、既存のパイプラインを補うためのボルトオン買収を行える余地は残す方針だと説明した。特に、免疫学、希少疾患、ワクチンの各分野で第１相・第２相臨床試験の段階にある新薬候補が対象になるという。

PNG Info
Pangolin is a multichain decentralized exchange (DEX) operating on the Avalanche Network, designed to provide users with advanced tooling, deep liquidity, and an easy onboarding process for a seamless trading experience.

This model promotes a decentralized and community-driven approach to the platform’s growth and governance.

ENJ infused NFTs will be up for grabs 👀
See you in the galaxy! pic.twitter.com/oULzQYeFVM

Nov 23, 2026

ENJ Info
Enjin is a comprehensive platform designed around the intersection of blockchain and gaming. Spearheaded by Enjin, this ecosystem offers a suite of interconnected gaming products with the Enjin Network at its core, where users engage in social gaming activities, including the creation of gaming websites, clans, chat forums, and virtual item storefronts.
Central to Enjin’s functionality is its ability to let developers tokenize in-game items on the Ethereum blockchain. Through this mechanism, real-world value is imparted to these digital assets, enabling their purchase, sale, and trade on integrated marketplaces. This digitization process does more than just virtualize items; it brings transparency, verifies authenticity, and guarantees the scarcity of the tokenized assets, enhancing their inherent value and utility across various applications.
Serving as the backbone of the Enjin ecosystem is the Enjin Coin (ENJ), an ERC-20 token. This digital store of value is integral to the creation and backing of blockchain assets, especially non-fungible tokens (NFTs). Every NFT produced within the Enjin platform has ENJ embedded within it, effectively locking this value and removing the corresponding ENJ from the general circulation. This system not only ensures that the assets possess inherent value but also provides liquidity and introduces an anti-inflationary model. Furthermore, Enjin’s distinctive “melting” feature grants users the option to dissolve their assets, subsequently reclaiming the intrinsic ENJ.

TRX Info
Tron (TRX) is a blockchain project designed to enable the creation of decentralized applications (dApps). Originally built on the Ethereum blockchain in 2017, Tron later migrated to its own network protocol. The Tron network offers high throughput and scalability, making it suitable for applications with a high volume of transactions, such as gaming and social media platforms.
One of the unique features of Tron is its three-layer architecture, consisting of the storage layer, the core protocol layer, and the application layer. This architecture provides great flexibility for developers and allows the creation of complex and functional applications.
The TRX token serves as the primary asset within the Tron network and is used to manage network resources, participate in voting, pay fees, and earn rewards through staking.
